/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureStrongAdditivity
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Integral

/-!
# The regular projection-valued measure of an original normal operator

The actual continuous functional calculus determines regular Riesz coefficient
measures and bounded set operators on the original complete Hilbert space.
Their proved projection, intersection and strong-additivity laws build the
projection-valued measure directly. Its scalar measures are those same Riesz
coefficients, so continuous spectral integration recovers the original CFC
and its coordinate value. This constructs the data required by Murphy's
resolutionOfIdentity without using the open numbered spectral theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual spectral measure computed from the original normal operator's CFC. -/
def normalCFCPVM (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure (spectrum ℂ T) H where
  toFun := normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT
  not_measurable' := fun hs => normalCFCCoefficientOperator_not_measurable T hT _ hs
  projection' := fun s _ => normalCFCCoefficientOperator_isStarProjection T hT s
  empty' := normalCFCCoefficientOperator_empty T hT
  univ' := normalCFCCoefficientOperator_univ T hT
  inter' := fun s hs t ht => (normalCFCCoefficientOperator_mul_inter T hT s hs t ht).symm
  m_iUnion' := normalCFCCoefficientOperator_m_iUnion T hT

/-- Every value is the actual bounded coefficient operator, with no new representation. -/
theorem normalCFCPVM_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (s : Set (spectrum ℂ T)) :
    normalCFCPVM T hT s = normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT s := rfl

/-- The scalar measures are exactly the original regular complex-Riesz coefficients. -/
theorem normalCFCPVM_scalarMeasure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (g h : H) :
    (normalCFCPVM T hT).scalarMeasure g h =
      (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) := by
  apply VectorMeasure.ext
  intro s hs
  rw [scalarMeasure_apply, normalCFCPVM_apply]
  exact normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT s hs g h

/-- Regularity belongs to these actual scalar measures on the original spectrum. -/
theorem normalCFCPVM_scalarMeasure_regular (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h : H) :
    _root_.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.HasRegularVariation ((normalCFCPVM T hT).scalarMeasure g h) := by
  rw [normalCFCPVM_scalarMeasure]
  exact (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h).property

/-- Continuous spectral integration is the original continuous functional calculus. -/
theorem normalCFCPVM_spectralIntegral_continuous (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (f : C(spectrum ℂ T, ℂ)) :
    (normalCFCPVM T hT).spectralIntegral (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap f) =
      cfcHom hT f := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  rw [inner_spectralIntegral_apply, normalCFCPVM_scalarMeasure, ← complexIntegralDual_apply]
  exact normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_represents T hT g h f

/-- The same computed PVM integrates the coordinate to the original normal operator. -/
theorem normalCFCPVM_spectralIntegral_coordinate (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) :
    (normalCFCPVM T hT).spectralIntegral
      (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofContinuousMap
        ((ContinuousMap.id ℂ).restrict (spectrum ℂ T))) = T := by
  rw [normalCFCPVM_spectralIntegral_continuous]
  exact cfcHom_id hT

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureCoefficients

/-!
# Sesquilinearity of the actual normal-CFC regular coefficient measures

These strict laws serve the bounded coefficient-operator construction needed
by resolutionOfIdentity and its Borel functional calculus. They use the actual
regular complex-Riesz measure and its existing strict linear equivalence with
the continuous dual, without any PVM, norm, field or desired-output premise.
The original complete H, normal T, coefficient orientation and scalar action
are retained. No terminal textbook theorem is proved or used here.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The first coefficient vector is additive for the actual regular complex measure. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_add_left (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g₁ g₂ h : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (g₁ + g₂) h =
      normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g₁ h + normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g₂ h := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_add]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, add_apply,
    map_add, inner_add_right]

/-- The first coefficient vector is complex-linear, with the original scalar action. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_smul_left (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (c : ℂ) (g h : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT (c • g) h =
      c • normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, smul_apply,
    map_smul, inner_smul_right, smul_eq_mul]

/-- The second coefficient vector is additive for the same measure. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_add_right (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g h₁ h₂ : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (h₁ + h₂) =
      normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h₁ + normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h₂ := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_add]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, add_apply,
    inner_add_left]

/-- The second coefficient vector is conjugate-linear, in the scalarMeasure g h orientation. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_smul_right (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (c : ℂ) (g h : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g (c • h) =
      star c • normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g h := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, smul_apply,
    inner_smul_left, smul_eq_mul, starRingEnd_apply]

/-- Zero in the first vector gives the actual zero regular complex measure. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_zero_left (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (h : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT 0 h = 0 := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_zero]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, zero_apply,
    map_zero, inner_zero_right]

/-- Zero in the second vector gives the actual zero regular complex measure. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientMeasure_zero_right (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T)
    (g : H) :
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT g 0 = 0 := by
  apply (MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv (X := spectrum ℂ T)).injective
  rw [map_zero]
  simp only [MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralEquiv_apply,
    normalCFCCoefficientMeasure, MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.complexIntegralDual_complexRieszMeasure]
  ext f
  simp only [normalCFCCoefficientFunctional_apply, zero_apply,
    inner_zero_left]

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.OrthogonalStrongSum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.CFCMeasureProjectionIntersection

/-!
# Strong countable additivity of the actual normal-CFC coefficient operators

The computed operators of disjoint measurable sets are orthogonal projections
by their actual intersection law. Their original complex coefficient measures
are countably additive. The existing strong orthogonal-projection sum is
therefore the computed operator of the union, identified on the same H by
its original inner coefficients. This supplies the strong-additivity field
needed by resolutionOfIdentity and borelFunctionalCalculus. No PVM, desired
limit, projection or coefficient-convergence certificate is an input.
Numbered textbook terminal theorem proofs remain wholly open.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Disjoint measurable computed coefficients sum in norm on every original vector. -/
theorem normalCFCCoefficientOperator_m_iUnion
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : IsStarNormal T) (s : ℕ → Set (spectrum ℂ T))
    (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n))
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (s i) (s j)) (g : H) :
    HasSum (fun n => normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s n) g)
      (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (⋃ n, s n) g) := by
  have hprojection (n : ℕ) : IsStarProjection (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s n)) :=
    normalCFCCoefficientOperator_isStarProjection T hT (s n)
  have horth : Pairwise fun i j =>
      normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s i) * normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s j) = 0 := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [normalCFCCoefficientOperator_mul_inter T hT (s i) (hs i) (s j) (hs j),
      Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (hdisj hij), normalCFCCoefficientOperator_empty]
  refine (hasSum_of_orthogonal_of_inner_hasSum
    (fun n => normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s n)) hprojection horth
    (normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (⋃ n, s n)) ?_) g
  intro x h
  have hu : MeasurableSet (⋃ n, s n) := MeasurableSet.iUnion hs
  have hf : (fun n => ⟪h, normalCFCCoefficientOperator T hT (s n) x⟫_ℂ) =
      (fun n => (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT x h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) (s n)) := by
    funext n
    exact normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT (s n) (hs n) x h
  rw [hf, normalCFCCoefficientOperator_coefficient T hT (⋃ n, s n) hu x h]
  exact VectorMeasure.m_iUnion
    (normalCFCCoefficientMeasure T hT x h : ComplexMeasure (spectrum ℂ T)) hs hdisj

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpHolder

/-!
# Constructions of projection-valued measures

This file supplies functorial and model constructions for projection-valued measures: transport by
a unitary equivalence, arbitrary Hilbert direct sums and inflations, and atomic diagonal measures.
All countable additivity remains pointwise-norm (strong-operator) additivity.

## Primary source

John B. Conway, *A Course in Functional Analysis*, 2nd ed., Chapter IX, §1,
Examples 1.7–1.8 (inflation and atomic measures). The direct-sum and atomic
models here allow arbitrary index types over measurable spaces; strong
countable additivity is expressed by pointwise `HasSum`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace Topology

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

universe u v w z

namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

/-! ## Unitary transport -/

variable {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X]
variable {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- Transport a projection-valued measure through a unitary linear equivalence. -/
noncomputable def unitaryTransport (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure X K where
  toFun s := U.conjStarAlgEquiv (E s)
  not_measurable' := by
    intro s hs
    rw [E.not_measurable hs, map_zero]
  projection' := by
    intro s hs
    exact (E.projection s hs).map U.conjStarAlgEquiv
  empty' := by rw [E.empty, map_zero]
  univ' := by rw [E.univ, map_one]
  inter' := by
    intro s hs t ht
    rw [E.inter s hs t ht, map_mul]
  m_iUnion' := by
    intro s hs hdisj y
    have hsum := E.m_iUnion s hs hdisj (U.symm y)
    have htransport := hsum.map U.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom U.continuous
    change HasSum (fun n ↦ U (E (s n) (U.symm y))) (U (E (⋃ n, s n) (U.symm y)))
      at htransport
    simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply] using htransport

@[simp]
theorem unitaryTransport_apply (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H)
    (s : Set X) (y : K) :
    unitaryTransport U E s y = U (E s (U.symm y)) :=
  rfl

/-- The range of a transported projection is the unitary image of the original range. -/
theorem range_unitaryTransport (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H)
    (s : Set X) :
    LinearMap.range (unitaryTransport U E s).toLinearMap =
      (LinearMap.range (E s).toLinearMap).map U.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨E s (U.symm z), ⟨U.symm z, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨U x, ?_⟩
    simp

@[simp]
theorem unitaryTransport_refl (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    unitaryTransport (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ H) E = E := by
  apply ext_measurable
  intro s _hs
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

variable {G : Type z} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℂ G] [CompleteSpace G]

/-- Successive unitary transports agree with transport through the composite unitary. -/
theorem unitaryTransport_trans (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (V : K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] G)
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    unitaryTransport V (unitaryTransport U E) = unitaryTransport (U.trans V) E := by
  apply ext_measurable
  intro s _hs
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem unitaryTransport_symm (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    unitaryTransport U.symm (unitaryTransport U E) = E := by
  simpa using unitaryTransport_trans U U.symm E

/-! ## Arbitrary Hilbert direct sums -/

section DirectSum

variable {ι : Type z} {F : ι → Type v}
variable [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (F i)] [∀ i, InnerProductSpace ℂ (F i)]
  [∀ i, CompleteSpace (F i)]

/-- The coordinatewise operator associated to a family of PVM values. -/
noncomputable def directSumValue (E : ∀ i, ProjectionValuedMeasure X (F i)) (s : Set X) :
    lp F 2 →L[ℂ] lp F 2 :=
  lp.mapCLM 2 (fun i ↦ E i s) zero_le_one fun i ↦
    IsStarProjection.norm_le _ ((E i).isStarProjection s)

@[simp]
theorem directSumValue_apply (E : ∀ i, ProjectionValuedMeasure X (F i))
    (s : Set X) (f : lp F 2) (i : ι) :
    directSumValue E s f i = E i s (f i) :=
  rfl

private theorem directSumValue_isStarProjection
    (E : ∀ i, ProjectionValuedMeasure X (F i)) (s : Set X) :
    IsStarProjection (directSumValue E s) := by
  constructor
  · change directSumValue E s * directSumValue E s = directSumValue E s
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply lp.ext
    funext i
    change E i s (E i s (f i)) = E i s (f i)
    simpa only [mul_apply_eq_comp] using
      congrArg (fun T : F i →L[ℂ] F i ↦ T (f i)) ((E i).isStarProjection s).isIdempotentElem.eq
  · rw [isSelfAdjoint_iff, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
    symm
    apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
    intro f g
    rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum, lp.inner_eq_tsum]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro i
    rw [directSumValue_apply, directSumValue_apply]
    calc
      ⟪E i s (f i), g i⟫_ℂ =
          ⟪f i, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (E i s)) (g i)⟫_ℂ :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (E i s) (f i) (g i)).symm
      _ = ⟪f i, E i s (g i)⟫_ℂ := by
        rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
          ((E i).isStarProjection s).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]

/-- The Hilbert direct sum of an arbitrary family of projection-valued measures. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def directSum (E : ∀ i, ProjectionValuedMeasure X (F i)) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure X (lp F 2) where
  toFun s := directSumValue E s
  not_measurable' := by
    intro s hs
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply lp.ext
    funext i
    simp [directSumValue_apply, (E i).not_measurable hs]
  projection' := fun s _hs ↦ directSumValue_isStarProjection E s
  empty' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply lp.ext
    funext i
    simp
  univ' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply lp.ext
    funext i
    simp
  inter' := by
    intro s hs t ht
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    apply lp.ext
    funext i
    simp only [directSumValue_apply, mul_apply_eq_comp]
    change E i (s ∩ t) (f i) = (E i s * E i t) (f i)
    rw [(E i).inter s hs t ht]
  m_iUnion' := by
    intro s hs hdisj f
    let P : ℕ → lp F 2 →L[ℂ] lp F 2 := fun n ↦ directSumValue E (s n)
    have hP (n : ℕ) : IsStarProjection (P n) := directSumValue_isStarProjection E (s n)
    have horth : Pairwise fun m n ↦ P m * P n = 0 := by
      intro m n hmn
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro y
      apply lp.ext
      funext i
      change E i (s m) (E i (s n) (y i)) = 0
      have hzero := (E i).mul_eq_zero_of_disjoint (hs m) (hs n) (hdisj hmn)
      simpa only [mul_apply_eq_comp, zero_apply] using
        congrArg (fun T : F i →L[ℂ] F i ↦ T (y i)) hzero
    obtain ⟨Q, _hQproj, hQsum, _hQrange⟩ :=
      exists_hasSum_of_pairwise_orthogonal P hP horth
    have hQeq : Q = directSumValue E (⋃ n, s n) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro y
      apply lp.ext
      funext i
      have hleft := (hQsum y).map (lp.evalCLM ℂ F 2 i).toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom
        (lp.evalCLM ℂ F 2 i).continuous
      have hright := (E i).m_iUnion s hs hdisj (y i)
      have hfamily : (fun n ↦ (P n y) i) = fun n ↦ E i (s n) (y i) := by
        funext n
        rfl
      change HasSum (fun n ↦ (P n y) i) ((Q y) i) at hleft
      rw [hfamily] at hleft
      change (Q y) i = E i (⋃ n, s n) (y i)
      exact hleft.unique hright
    rw [← hQeq]
    exact hQsum f

@[simp]
theorem directSum_apply (E : ∀ i, ProjectionValuedMeasure X (F i))
    (s : Set X) (f : lp F 2) (i : ι) :
    directSum E s f i = E i s (f i) := by
  change directSumValue E s f i = E i s (f i)
  exact directSumValue_apply E s f i

/-- Inflation of a PVM by an arbitrary index type. -/
noncomputable def inflate (ι : Type z) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure X (lp (fun _ : ι ↦ H) 2) :=
  directSum (fun _ : ι ↦ E)

@[simp]
theorem inflate_apply (ι : Type z) (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H)
    (s : Set X) (f : lp (fun _ : ι ↦ H) 2) (i : ι) :
    inflate ι E s f i = E s (f i) := by
  change directSum (fun _ : ι ↦ E) s f i = E s (f i)
  exact directSum_apply (fun _ : ι ↦ E) s f i

end DirectSum

/-! ## Atomic diagonal PVMs -/

section Atomic

variable {ι : Type z}

open scoped Classical

/-- The diagonal atomic PVM determined by points `x i`. Repeated points are allowed. -/
noncomputable def atomicDiagonal (x : ι → X) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure X (lp (fun _ : ι ↦ ℂ) 2) :=
  directSum fun i ↦ ProjectionValuedMeasure.dirac (H := ℂ) (x i)

@[simp]
theorem atomicDiagonal_apply_of_mem (x : ι → X) {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (f : lp (fun _ : ι ↦ ℂ) 2) {i : ι} (hi : x i ∈ s) :
    atomicDiagonal x s f i = f i := by
  rw [atomicDiagonal, directSum_apply, dirac_apply_of_mem (x i) hs hi, one_apply_eq_self]

@[simp]
theorem atomicDiagonal_apply_of_not_mem (x : ι → X) {s : Set X}
    (f : lp (fun _ : ι ↦ ℂ) 2) {i : ι} (hi : x i ∉ s) :
    atomicDiagonal x s f i = 0 := by
  rw [atomicDiagonal, directSum_apply, dirac_apply_of_not_mem (x i) hi, zero_apply]

theorem atomicDiagonal_apply (x : ι → X) {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (f : lp (fun _ : ι ↦ ℂ) 2) (i : ι) :
    atomicDiagonal x s f i = if x i ∈ s then f i else 0 := by
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact atomicDiagonal_apply_of_mem x hs f hi
  · exact atomicDiagonal_apply_of_not_mem x f hi

variable {L : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup L] [InnerProductSpace ℂ L] [CompleteSpace L]

/-- Transport the atomic diagonal PVM through a Hilbert basis. -/
noncomputable def atomicOfHilbertBasis (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ L) (x : ι → X) :
    ProjectionValuedMeasure X L :=
  unitaryTransport b.repr.symm (atomicDiagonal x)

/-- Coordinate action of the atomic PVM transported through a Hilbert basis. -/
theorem atomicOfHilbertBasis_repr_apply (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ L) (x : ι → X)
    {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (v : L) (i : ι) :
    b.repr (atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s v) i =
      if x i ∈ s then b.repr v i else 0 := by
  rw [atomicOfHilbertBasis, unitaryTransport_apply]
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    atomicDiagonal_apply x hs (b.repr v) i

@[simp]
theorem atomicOfHilbertBasis_apply_basis_of_mem (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ L) (x : ι → X)
    {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {i : ι} (hi : x i ∈ s) :
    atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s (b i) = b i := by
  classical
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext j
  rw [atomicOfHilbertBasis_repr_apply b x hs]
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [b.repr_self, lp.single_apply, hi]
  · simp [b.repr_self, lp.single_apply, hji]

@[simp]
theorem atomicOfHilbertBasis_apply_basis_of_not_mem (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ L) (x : ι → X)
    {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {i : ι} (hi : x i ∉ s) :
    atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s (b i) = 0 := by
  classical
  apply b.repr.injective
  ext j
  rw [atomicOfHilbertBasis_repr_apply b x hs]
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [hi]
  · simp [b.repr_self, lp.single_apply, hji]

/-- The range of an atomic Hilbert-basis projection is the closed span of the selected basis
vectors. -/
theorem range_atomicOfHilbertBasis (b : HilbertBasis ι ℂ L) (x : ι → X)
    (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    LinearMap.range (atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s).toLinearMap =
      (Submodule.span ℂ (b '' {i | x i ∈ s})).topologicalClosure := by
  let P := atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨v, rfl⟩
    have hsum := b.hasSum_repr (P v)
    apply mem_closure_of_tendsto hsum
    filter_upwards with u
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i hiu
    by_cases hi : x i ∈ s
    · apply Submodule.smul_mem
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    · have hcoeff : b.repr (P v) i = 0 := by
        simpa only [P, ite_eq_right hi] using atomicOfHilbertBasis_repr_apply b x hs v i
      simp [hcoeff]
  · apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal
    · apply Submodule.span_le.2
      rintro y ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨b i, atomicOfHilbertBasis_apply_basis_of_mem b x hs hi⟩
    · let T := atomicOfHilbertBasis b x s
      have hT : T * T = T := ((atomicOfHilbertBasis b x).projection s hs).isIdempotentElem
      have hRange : (LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap : Set L) = {y | T y = y} := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
          change T (T z) = T z
          simpa only [mul_apply_eq_comp] using
            congrArg (fun S : L →L[ℂ] L ↦ S z) hT
        · intro hy
          exact ⟨y, hy⟩
      change IsClosed (LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap : Set L)
      rw [hRange]
      exact isClosed_eq T.continuous continuous_id

end Atomic

end ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Integral
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.SpecialFunctions.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric

/-!
# Actual bounded spectral imaginary-power coordinates

The bounded Borel coordinate is exp(it log r). On the positive real spectrum
this is the original r^(it). The total real-log convention is immaterial to
a positive nonsingular operator's spectral measure, which assigns zero to
the nonpositive excluded spectrum. The coordinate has modulus one at every
real r and is integrated using the existing strict bounded PVM integral.

These are actual coordinate/operator DATA from a given spectral measure.
No source Delta, spectral resolution, polar decomposition or unitary family
is selected from an open theorem. Positivity, nonsingularity and the link to
a given original operator are retained in the later whole source statement.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace
namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

noncomputable section

open _root_.MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure

/-- The actual bounded measurable exp(it log r) coordinate on the real spectral axis. -/
def imaginaryPowerCoordinate (t : ℝ) : BoundedMeasurableFunction ℝ := by
  refine ⟨⟨(show PreLp (fun _ : ℝ => ℂ) from
    fun r => Complex.exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.log r : ℂ))), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · change Memℓp (fun r : ℝ => Complex.exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.log r : ℂ))) (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)
    rw [memℓp_infty_iff]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    change ‖Complex.exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.log r : ℂ))‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  · change Measurable fun r : ℝ => Complex.exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.log r : ℂ))
    exact Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
      (measurable_const.mul (Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp Real.measurable_log))

/-- The coordinate retains its exact original positive-spectral exponential/logarithm value. -/
@[simp]
theorem imaginaryPowerCoordinate_apply (t r : ℝ) :
    imaginaryPowerCoordinate t r = Complex.exp (((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Real.log r : ℂ)) :=
  rfl

/-- The actual imaginary-power coordinate has modulus one on the whole real axis. -/
theorem imaginaryPowerCoordinate_norm (t r : ℝ) : ‖imaginaryPowerCoordinate t r‖ = 1 := by
  rw [imaginaryPowerCoordinate_apply, Complex.norm_exp]
  simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual bounded spectral integral of the original imaginary-power coordinate. -/
def spectralImaginaryPower (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure ℝ H) (t : ℝ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  E.spectralIntegral (imaginaryPowerCoordinate t)

/-- Every coefficient of the actual power is the original spectral coefficient integral. -/
theorem spectralImaginaryPower_inner (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (g h : H) :
    inner ℂ h (spectralImaginaryPower E t g) = complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) (imaginaryPowerCoordinate t) :=
  inner_spectralIntegral_apply E (imaginaryPowerCoordinate t) g h

end

end ProjectionValuedMeasure
end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.ScalarMeasure
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.ComplexIntegral
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# Spectral integration for projection-valued measures

This file constructs the bounded operator integral of a bounded measurable
complex-valued function against a projection-valued measure.  The construction
is characterized by its scalar coefficients and agrees with the canonical
finite sum on measurable simple functions.  It also provides the contraction,
Lipschitz, strict simple-function approximation, and uniqueness interfaces
needed for the later algebraic extension.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace NNReal

open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function
open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace
namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {X : Type u} {H : Type v}
variable [MeasurableSpace X]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

private noncomputable def spectralIntegralFormLinear
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    H →ₗ⋆[ℂ] H →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun h :=
    { toFun := fun g ↦ complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi
      map_add' := by
        intro g₁ g₂
        rw [E.scalarMeasure_add_left, complexIntegral_add_measure]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c g
        rw [E.scalarMeasure_smul_left, complexIntegral_smul_measure]
        rfl }
  map_add' := by
    intro h₁ h₂
    ext g
    change complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g (h₁ + h₂)) phi =
      complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h₁) phi + complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h₂) phi
    rw [E.scalarMeasure_add_right, complexIntegral_add_measure]
  map_smul' := by
    intro c h
    ext g
    change complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g (c • h)) phi =
      star c • complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi
    rw [E.scalarMeasure_smul_right, complexIntegral_smul_measure]

private theorem norm_spectralIntegralFormLinear_apply_le
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) (h g : H) :
    ‖spectralIntegralFormLinear E phi h g‖ ≤ ‖phi‖ * ‖h‖ * ‖g‖ := by
  calc
    ‖spectralIntegralFormLinear E phi h g‖ =
        ‖complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ‖phi‖ * (E.scalarMeasure g h).variation.real Set.univ :=
      norm_complexIntegral_le (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi
    _ ≤ ‖phi‖ * (‖g‖ * ‖h‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (E.scalarMeasure_variation_real_univ_le g h)
        (norm_nonneg phi)
    _ = ‖phi‖ * ‖h‖ * ‖g‖ := by ring

/-- The bounded sesquilinear coefficient form of the spectral integral.  It is
conjugate-linear in the first vector and linear in the second. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def spectralIntegralForm
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    H →L⋆[ℂ] H →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous₂ (spectralIntegralFormLinear E phi) ‖phi‖
    (norm_spectralIntegralFormLinear_apply_le E phi)

@[simp]
theorem spectralIntegralForm_apply
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) (h g : H) :
    spectralIntegralForm E phi h g = complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi := by
  simp [spectralIntegralForm, spectralIntegralFormLinear]

/-- The bounded operator integral of `phi` against `E`.  The adjoint is required
because Mathlib's inner product is conjugate-linear in its first argument. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def spectralIntegral
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    H →L[ℂ] H :=
  (InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin (spectralIntegralForm E phi)).adjoint

/-- Characteristic scalar-coefficient identity for the spectral integral. -/
theorem inner_spectralIntegral_apply
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) (g h : H) :
    ⟪h, spectralIntegral E phi g⟫_ℂ = complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi := by
  rw [spectralIntegral]
  calc
    ⟪h, (InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin
          (spectralIntegralForm E phi)).adjoint g⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin (spectralIntegralForm E phi) h, g⟫_ℂ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right _ _ _
    _ = spectralIntegralForm E phi h g :=
      InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply _ _ _
    _ = complexIntegral (E.scalarMeasure g h) phi :=
      spectralIntegralForm_apply E phi h g

private theorem norm_spectralIntegral_apply_le
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) (g : H) :
    ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ ≤ ‖phi‖ * ‖g‖ := by
  by_cases hg : spectralIntegral E phi g = 0
  · rw [hg, norm_zero]
    positivity
  · have hpos : 0 < ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hg
    have hbound :
        ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ * ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ ≤
          (‖phi‖ * ‖g‖) * ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ := calc
      ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ * ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ =
          ‖⟪spectralIntegral E phi g, spectralIntegral E phi g⟫_ℂ‖ := by
        rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
        simp [pow_two]
      _ = ‖complexIntegral
          (E.scalarMeasure g (spectralIntegral E phi g)) phi‖ := by
        rw [inner_spectralIntegral_apply]
      _ ≤ ‖phi‖ *
          (E.scalarMeasure g (spectralIntegral E phi g)).variation.real Set.univ :=
        norm_complexIntegral_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖phi‖ * (‖g‖ * ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (E.scalarMeasure_variation_real_univ_le g (spectralIntegral E phi g))
          (norm_nonneg phi)
      _ = (‖phi‖ * ‖g‖) * ‖spectralIntegral E phi g‖ := by ring
    nlinarith

/-- Spectral integration is contractive for the supremum norm. -/
theorem norm_spectralIntegral_le
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    ‖spectralIntegral E phi‖ ≤ ‖phi‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg phi)
  exact norm_spectralIntegral_apply_le E phi

theorem spectralIntegral_add
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegral E (phi + psi) = spectralIntegral E phi + spectralIntegral E psi := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  simp only [inner_spectralIntegral_apply, add_apply, inner_add_right,
    complexIntegral_add]

theorem spectralIntegral_smul
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (c : ℂ) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegral E (c • phi) = c • spectralIntegral E phi := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  simp only [inner_spectralIntegral_apply, smul_apply, inner_smul_right,
    complexIntegral_smul, smul_eq_mul]

/-- Spectral integration as a contraction between normed complex spaces. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def spectralIntegralCLM (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := spectralIntegral E
      map_add' := by
        intro phi psi
        exact spectralIntegral_add E phi psi
      map_smul' := by
        intro c phi
        exact spectralIntegral_smul E c phi }
    1
    (fun phi ↦ by simpa using norm_spectralIntegral_le E phi)

@[simp]
theorem spectralIntegralCLM_apply
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegralCLM E phi = spectralIntegral E phi := by
  simp [spectralIntegralCLM]

/-- Difference form of the contraction estimate. -/
theorem norm_spectralIntegral_sub_le
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    ‖spectralIntegral E phi - spectralIntegral E psi‖ ≤ ‖phi - psi‖ := by
  calc
    ‖spectralIntegral E phi - spectralIntegral E psi‖ =
        ‖spectralIntegralCLM E phi - spectralIntegralCLM E psi‖ := by
      rw [spectralIntegralCLM_apply, spectralIntegralCLM_apply]
    _ = ‖spectralIntegralCLM E (phi - psi)‖ := by
      let F : BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := spectralIntegralCLM E
      have hsub : F (phi - psi) = F phi - F psi := F.map_sub phi psi
      exact congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => ‖T‖) hsub.symm
    _ = ‖spectralIntegral E (phi - psi)‖ := by rw [spectralIntegralCLM_apply]
    _ ≤ ‖phi - psi‖ := norm_spectralIntegral_le E (phi - psi)

/-- Metric form of the contraction estimate. -/
theorem dist_spectralIntegral_le
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    dist (spectralIntegral E phi) (spectralIntegral E psi) ≤ dist phi psi := by
  calc
    dist (spectralIntegral E phi) (spectralIntegral E psi) =
        ‖spectralIntegral E phi - spectralIntegral E psi‖ := dist_eq_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖phi - psi‖ := norm_spectralIntegral_sub_le E phi psi
    _ = dist phi psi := (dist_eq_norm phi psi).symm

/-- The canonical finite operator sum attached to a measurable simple
function. -/
noncomputable def simpleSpectralIntegral
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  ∑ c ∈ f.range, c • E (f ⁻¹' {c})

/-- Spectral integration agrees with the canonical finite sum on measurable
simple functions. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) =
      simpleSpectralIntegral E f := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  rw [inner_spectralIntegral_apply, complexIntegral_ofSimpleFunc]
  rw [simpleSpectralIntegral]
  simp only [ProjectionValuedMeasure.scalarMeasure_apply, sum_apply, inner_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c hc
  rw [smul_apply, inner_smul_right]

/-- Integral of a constant-valued measurable indicator. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_indicatorConst
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (c : ℂ) :
    spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs c) = c • E s := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro h
  rw [inner_spectralIntegral_apply, complexIntegral_indicatorConst,
    ProjectionValuedMeasure.scalarMeasure_apply]
  change c * ⟪h, E s g⟫_ℂ = ⟪h, c • E s g⟫_ℂ
  rw [inner_smul_right]

/-- Integral of a measurable characteristic function. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_indicator
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator s hs) = E s := by
  simpa [BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator] using
    spectralIntegral_indicatorConst E s hs (1 : ℂ)

/-- A uniform simple approximation with margin `delta < epsilon` gives the
strict operator-norm estimate required by the finite-partition construction. -/
theorem norm_spectralIntegral_sub_simpleSpectralIntegral_lt
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X)
    (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) {delta epsilon : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hdeltaepsilon : delta < epsilon)
    (happrox : ∀ x, ‖phi x - f x‖ ≤ delta) :
    ‖spectralIntegral E phi - simpleSpectralIntegral E f‖ < epsilon := by
  have hnorm : ‖phi - BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f‖ ≤ delta := by
    change ‖(phi - BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f).toLp‖ ≤ delta
    apply lp.norm_le_of_forall_le hdelta
    intro x
    change ‖phi x - BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f x‖ ≤ delta
    simpa only [BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc_apply] using happrox x
  rw [← spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc E f]
  exact (norm_spectralIntegral_sub_le E phi
    (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)).trans_lt
      (hnorm.trans_lt hdeltaepsilon)

/-- Every spectral integral is a strict operator-norm limit of canonical
finite simple-function sums. -/
theorem exists_simpleSpectralIntegral_norm_sub_lt
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X)
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      ‖spectralIntegral E phi - simpleSpectralIntegral E f‖ < epsilon := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := BoundedMeasurableFunction.exists_simpleFunc_norm_sub_lt phi hepsilon
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  rw [← spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc E f]
  exact (norm_spectralIntegral_sub_le E phi
    (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)).trans_lt hf

private theorem dense_range_ofSimpleFunc :
    Dense (Set.range (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc :
      SimpleFunc X ℂ → BoundedMeasurableFunction X)) := by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro phi epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := BoundedMeasurableFunction.exists_simpleFunc_norm_sub_lt phi hepsilon
  refine ⟨BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f, ?_, ⟨f, rfl⟩⟩
  simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hf

/-- The coefficient construction is the unique continuous linear extension of
the canonical simple-function sums. -/
theorem spectralIntegralCLM_unique
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H)
    (T : BoundedMeasurableFunction X →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hT : ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      T (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) = simpleSpectralIntegral E f) :
    T = spectralIntegralCLM E := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on
    (dense_range_ofSimpleFunc (X := X) |>.mono Submodule.subset_span)
  rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
  rw [hT f, spectralIntegralCLM_apply, spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc]

end

end ProjectionValuedMeasure
end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

Author: @toskua, Avocado

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Integral

/-!
# The spectral-integral representation

Spectral integration sends bounded measurable functions to bounded operators as a unital complex
star-algebra homomorphism.  Multiplication and star preservation are first proved for measurable
simple functions by refining their measurable fibers, then extended through uniform simple-function
density and continuity.  No regularity, separability, or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

## Primary source

John B. Conway, *A Course in Functional Analysis*, 2nd ed., Chapter IX, §1,
Proposition 1.12. The domain is bounded measurable functions on an arbitrary
measurable space. Reconstruction converses for continuous-function algebras,
including noncompact `C₀(X)`, are outside this module.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProductSpace Topology

open MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace
namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {X : Type u} {H : Type v}
variable [MeasurableSpace X]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

private theorem ofSimpleFunc_eq_sum_indicatorConst (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f =
      ∑ c ∈ f.range, BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
        (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) c := by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply lp.ext
  funext x
  change BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f x =
    (∑ c ∈ f.range, BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
      (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) c) x
  have hsum := congrArg (fun q : lp (fun _ : X ↦ ℂ) ⊤ ↦ q x)
    (map_sum (boundedMeasurableFunctions X).subtype
      (fun c ↦ BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
        (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) c) f.range)
  have hsum_apply :
      (∑ c ∈ f.range, BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
        (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) c) x =
      ∑ c ∈ f.range, (f ⁻¹' {c}).indicator (fun _ ↦ c) x := by
    simpa only [StarSubalgebra.subtype_apply, lp.coeFn_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply] using hsum
  rw [BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc_apply, hsum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (f x)]
  · simp
  · intro c hc hcf
    simp [hcf.symm]
  · exact fun hnot ↦ (hnot (f.mem_range_self x)).elim

private theorem star_indicatorConst (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (c : ℂ) :
    star (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs c) =
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs (star c) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply lp.ext
  funext x
  change star (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs c x) = _
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply, hx]

private theorem indicatorConst_mul (s t : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) (c d : ℂ) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs c *
        BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst t ht d =
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst (s ∩ t) (hs.inter ht) (c * d) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply lp.ext
  funext x
  change BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst s hs c x *
      BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst t ht d x = _
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> by_cases hxt : x ∈ t <;>
    simp [BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst_apply, hxs, hxt]

private theorem spectralIntegral_star_ofSimpleFunc
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    spectralIntegral E (star (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)) =
      star (spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)) := by
  classical
  calc
    spectralIntegral E (star (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)) =
        spectralIntegral E
          (∑ c ∈ f.range, BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
            (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) (star c)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [ofSimpleFunc_eq_sum_indicatorConst, star_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      exact star_indicatorConst (f ⁻¹' {c}) (f.measurableSet_fiber c) c
    _ = ∑ c ∈ f.range, star c • E (f ⁻¹' {c}) := by
      rw [← spectralIntegralCLM_apply]
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      rw [spectralIntegralCLM_apply, spectralIntegral_indicatorConst]
    _ = star (simpleSpectralIntegral E f) := by
      rw [simpleSpectralIntegral, star_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      rw [star_smul, (E.isStarProjection (f ⁻¹' {c})).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]
    _ = star (spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f)) := by
      rw [spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc]

private theorem smul_projection_mul_smul_projection
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (s t : Set X)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (c d : ℂ) :
    (c • E s) * (d • E t) = (c * d) • E (s ∩ t) := by
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, ← E.inter s hs t ht]

private theorem simpleSpectralIntegral_mul
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    simpleSpectralIntegral E f * simpleSpectralIntegral E g =
      ∑ c ∈ f.range, ∑ d ∈ g.range,
        (c * d) • E ((f ⁻¹' {c}) ∩ (g ⁻¹' {d})) := by
  classical
  rw [simpleSpectralIntegral, simpleSpectralIntegral, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c hc
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  exact smul_projection_mul_smul_projection E _ _
    (f.measurableSet_fiber c) (g.measurableSet_fiber d) c d

private theorem spectralIntegral_mul_ofSimpleFunc
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
    spectralIntegral E
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) =
      spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) *
        spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) := by
  classical
  calc
    spectralIntegral E
        (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f *
          BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) =
        spectralIntegral E
          (∑ c ∈ f.range, ∑ d ∈ g.range,
            BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicatorConst
              ((f ⁻¹' {c}) ∩ (g ⁻¹' {d}))
              ((f.measurableSet_fiber c).inter (g.measurableSet_fiber d)) (c * d)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [ofSimpleFunc_eq_sum_indicatorConst, ofSimpleFunc_eq_sum_indicatorConst,
        Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact indicatorConst_mul _ _ (f.measurableSet_fiber c)
        (g.measurableSet_fiber d) c d
    _ = ∑ c ∈ f.range, ∑ d ∈ g.range,
        (c * d) • E ((f ⁻¹' {c}) ∩ (g ⁻¹' {d})) := by
      rw [← spectralIntegralCLM_apply]
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [spectralIntegralCLM_apply, spectralIntegral_indicatorConst]
    _ = simpleSpectralIntegral E f * simpleSpectralIntegral E g :=
      (simpleSpectralIntegral_mul E f g).symm
    _ = spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc f) *
        spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) := by
      rw [spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc, spectralIntegral_ofSimpleFunc]

private theorem denseRange_ofSimpleFunc :
    DenseRange (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc :
      SimpleFunc X ℂ → BoundedMeasurableFunction X) := by
  rw [Metric.denseRange_iff]
  intro phi epsilon hepsilon
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := BoundedMeasurableFunction.exists_simpleFunc_norm_sub_lt phi hepsilon
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  simpa [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hf

/-- Spectral integration preserves the pointwise star operation. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_star
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegral E (star phi) = star (spectralIntegral E phi) := by
  have hstar : Continuous (star : BoundedMeasurableFunction X →
      BoundedMeasurableFunction X) := by
    exact continuous_induced_rng.2
      (continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (Subtype.val :
        BoundedMeasurableFunction X → lp (fun _ : X ↦ ℂ) ⊤)).star
  have hEq :
      (fun psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X ↦ spectralIntegral E (star psi)) =
        fun psi ↦ star (spectralIntegral E psi) := by
    apply denseRange_ofSimpleFunc (X := X) |>.equalizer
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def, spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
        (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.comp hstar
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def, spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
        continuous_star.comp (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous
    · funext f
      exact spectralIntegral_star_ofSimpleFunc E f
  exact congrFun hEq phi

/-- Spectral integration preserves multiplication. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_mul
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegral E (phi * psi) = spectralIntegral E phi * spectralIntegral E psi := by
  have hright (g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) :
      ∀ theta : BoundedMeasurableFunction X,
        spectralIntegral E (theta * BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) =
          spectralIntegral E theta *
            spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) := by
    have hEq :
        (fun theta : BoundedMeasurableFunction X ↦
          spectralIntegral E (theta * BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g)) =
          fun theta ↦ spectralIntegral E theta *
            spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) := by
      apply denseRange_ofSimpleFunc (X := X) |>.equalizer
      · have hm : Continuous (fun theta : BoundedMeasurableFunction X ↦
            theta * BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g) := by
          exact continuous_id'.mul_const (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g)
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
          (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.comp hm
      · simpa only [spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
          (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.mul_const
            (spectralIntegral E (BoundedMeasurableFunction.ofSimpleFunc g))
      · funext f
        exact spectralIntegral_mul_ofSimpleFunc E f g
    exact fun theta ↦ congrFun hEq theta
  have hEq :
      (fun theta : BoundedMeasurableFunction X ↦ spectralIntegral E (phi * theta)) =
        fun theta ↦ spectralIntegral E phi * spectralIntegral E theta := by
    apply denseRange_ofSimpleFunc (X := X) |>.equalizer
    · have hm : Continuous (fun theta : BoundedMeasurableFunction X ↦
          phi * theta) := by
        exact continuous_id'.const_mul phi
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
        (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.comp hm
    · simpa only [spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
        (spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.const_mul (spectralIntegral E phi)
    · funext g
      exact hright g phi
  exact congrFun hEq psi

/-- The spectral integral of the constant-one function is the identity operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem spectralIntegral_one (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    spectralIntegral E (1 : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) = 1 := by
  calc
    spectralIntegral E (1 : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) =
        spectralIntegral E
          (BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator (Set.univ : Set X) MeasurableSet.univ) := by
      rw [BoundedMeasurableFunction.indicator_univ]
    _ = E Set.univ := spectralIntegral_indicator E Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    _ = 1 := E.univ

/-- Bounded spectral integration as a unital complex star-algebra homomorphism. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def spectralIntegralStarAlgHom (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) :
    BoundedMeasurableFunction X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) where
  toFun := spectralIntegral E
  map_one' := spectralIntegral_one E
  map_mul' := spectralIntegral_mul E
  map_zero' := by
    simpa only [spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using (spectralIntegralCLM E).map_zero
  map_add' := spectralIntegral_add E
  commutes' := by
    intro c
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, spectralIntegral_smul, spectralIntegral_one,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  map_star' := spectralIntegral_star E

@[simp]
theorem spectralIntegralStarAlgHom_apply
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    spectralIntegralStarAlgHom E phi = spectralIntegral E phi := by
  rfl

/-- Spectral integrals of two bounded measurable functions commute. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_commute
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    Commute (spectralIntegral E phi) (spectralIntegral E psi) := by
  change Commute (spectralIntegralStarAlgHom E phi) (spectralIntegralStarAlgHom E psi)
  exact (Commute.all phi psi).map (spectralIntegralStarAlgHom E)

/-- Every bounded spectral integral is a normal operator. -/
theorem spectralIntegral_isStarNormal
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) (phi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X) :
    IsStarNormal (spectralIntegral E phi) := by
  constructor
  rw [← spectralIntegral_star E phi]
  exact spectralIntegral_commute E (star phi) phi

/-- Uniform convergence of bounded measurable functions along any filter implies operator-norm
convergence of their spectral integrals. -/
theorem tendsto_spectralIntegral {I : Type*} {l : Filter I}
    (E : ProjectionValuedMeasure X H) {phi : I → BoundedMeasurableFunction X}
    {psi : BoundedMeasurableFunction X} (hphi : Tendsto phi l (𝓝 psi)) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ spectralIntegral E (phi i)) l (𝓝 (spectralIntegral E psi)) := by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, spectralIntegralCLM_apply] using
    ((spectralIntegralCLM E).continuous.tendsto psi).comp hphi

end

end ProjectionValuedMeasure
end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.SupportedOn
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Complete
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Indicator
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

/-!
# The indicator-multiplication projection-valued measure on `L²`

For every measure `μ`, measurable sets act on `Lp ℂ 2 μ` by multiplication by their
indicators. These operators form a projection-valued measure with strong countable additivity. No
finiteness, sigma-finiteness, nonzero-measure, or nonempty-space hypothesis is required.

## Primary source

John B. Conway, *A Course in Functional Analysis*, 2nd ed., Chapter IX, §1,
Example 1.6. The compact Borel-space example is generalized here to arbitrary
measure spaces, with strong countable additivity expressed by pointwise `HasSum`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory Topology

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace ProjectionValuedMeasure

variable {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X)

private noncomputable def indicatorLinearMap (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Lp ℂ 2 mu →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 mu where
  toFun f := ((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ f x)
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [((Lp.memLp (f + g)).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp,
      ((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp,
      ((Lp.memLp g).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp, Lp.coeFn_add f g,
      Lp.coeFn_add (((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ f x))
        (((Lp.memLp g).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ g x))] with x hfg
            hf hg hadd ht
    rw [hfg, ht, Pi.add_apply, hf, hg]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      rw [hadd, Pi.add_apply]
    · simp [hx]
  map_smul' c f := by
    change ((Lp.memLp (c • f)).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp
        (s.indicator fun x ↦ (c • f) x) =
      c • ((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ f x)
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [((Lp.memLp (c • f)).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp,
      ((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp, Lp.coeFn_smul c f,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c
          (((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ f x))]
      with x hcf hf hsmul ht
    rw [hcf, ht, Pi.smul_apply, hf]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      rw [hsmul, Pi.smul_apply]
    · simp [hx]

private theorem norm_indicatorLinearMap_le (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 mu) :
    ‖indicatorLinearMap mu s hs f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := by
  change ‖((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).toLp (s.indicator fun x ↦ f x)‖ ≤ ‖f‖
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_def]
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top f)
  exact eLpNorm_indicator_le (fun x ↦ f x) hs.nullMeasurableSet

/-- Multiplication by a measurable-set indicator as a bounded operator on `L²`. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def indicatorProjection (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Lp ℂ 2 mu →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 mu :=
  (indicatorLinearMap mu s hs).mkContinuous 1 fun f ↦ by
    simpa only [one_mul] using norm_indicatorLinearMap_le mu s hs f

/-- The indicator projection has its expected pointwise representative. -/
theorem indicatorProjection_apply (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (f : Lp ℂ 2 mu) :
    indicatorProjection mu s hs f =ᵐ[mu] s.indicator fun x ↦ f x :=
  ((Lp.memLp f).indicator hs.nullMeasurableSet).coeFn_toLp

@[simp]
theorem indicatorProjection_empty :
    indicatorProjection mu ∅ MeasurableSet.empty = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  rw [zero_apply]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu ∅ MeasurableSet.empty f,
    Lp.coeFn_zero ℂ 2 mu] with x hf hzero
  have hf' : indicatorProjection mu ∅ MeasurableSet.empty f x = 0 := by
    simpa only [Set.indicator_empty, Pi.zero_apply] using hf
  exact hf'.trans (by simpa only [Pi.zero_apply] using hzero.symm)

@[simp]
theorem indicatorProjection_univ :
    indicatorProjection mu Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ f] with x hf
  simpa using hf

/-- Indicator projections multiply by intersecting their measurable sets. -/
theorem indicatorProjection_inter (s t : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    indicatorProjection mu (s ∩ t) (hs.inter ht) =
      indicatorProjection mu s hs * indicatorProjection mu t ht := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change indicatorProjection mu (s ∩ t) (hs.inter ht) f =
    indicatorProjection mu s hs (indicatorProjection mu t ht f)
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu (s ∩ t) (hs.inter ht) f,
    indicatorProjection_apply mu t ht f,
    indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs (indicatorProjection mu t ht f)] with x hst ht' hs'
  rw [hst, hs']
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> by_cases hxt : x ∈ t <;> simp [hxs, hxt, ht']

/-- Indicator projections are finitely additive on disjoint measurable sets. -/
theorem indicatorProjection_union {s t : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hdisj : Disjoint s t) :
    indicatorProjection mu (s ∪ t) (hs.union ht) =
      indicatorProjection mu s hs + indicatorProjection mu t ht := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  change indicatorProjection mu (s ∪ t) (hs.union ht) f =
    indicatorProjection mu s hs f + indicatorProjection mu t ht f
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu (s ∪ t) (hs.union ht) f,
    indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs f, indicatorProjection_apply mu t ht f,
    Lp.coeFn_add (indicatorProjection mu s hs f) (indicatorProjection mu t ht f)]
      with x hu hs' ht' hadd
  rw [hu, hadd, Pi.add_apply, hs', ht']
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> by_cases hxt : x ∈ t
  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hxs hxt).elim
  all_goals simp [hxs, hxt]

/-- Multiplication by an indicator is an orthogonal projection. -/
theorem indicatorProjection_isStarProjection (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    IsStarProjection (indicatorProjection mu s hs) := by
  constructor
  · change indicatorProjection mu s hs * indicatorProjection mu s hs =
      indicatorProjection mu s hs
    simpa only [Set.inter_self] using (indicatorProjection_inter mu s s hs hs).symm
  · rw [isSelfAdjoint_iff, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
    symm
    apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
    intro f g
    rw [L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs f,
      indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs g] with x hf hg
    rw [hf, hg]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [hx]

/-- The closed subspace of `L²` functions vanishing almost everywhere off `s`. -/
abbrev indicatorRange (s : Set X) : Submodule ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 mu) :=
  MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.Lp.supportedOn
    (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := ℂ) (p := 2) mu s

/-- The range of the indicator projection consists exactly of functions supported on the set. -/
theorem range_indicatorProjection (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    LinearMap.range (indicatorProjection mu s hs).toLinearMap = indicatorRange mu s := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro f ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂mu, x ∉ s → indicatorProjection mu s hs g x = 0
    filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs g] with x hx
    intro hxs
    rw [hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxs]
  · intro f hf
    refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
    change indicatorProjection mu s hs f = f
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂mu, x ∉ s → f x = 0 at hf
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs f, hf] with x hproj hf
    rw [hproj]
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxs]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxs, hf hxs]

private theorem indicatorProjection_biUnion_finset {I : Type*} (u : Finset I)
    (s : I → Set X) (hs : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i))
    (hdisj : (u : Set I).PairwiseDisjoint s) :
    indicatorProjection mu (⋃ i ∈ u, s i) (Finset.measurableSet_biUnion u fun i _ ↦ hs i) =
      ∑ i ∈ u, indicatorProjection mu (s i) (hs i) := by
  classical
  induction u using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a u hau ih =>
      have ha : MeasurableSet (s a) := hs a
      have hu : MeasurableSet (⋃ i ∈ u, s i) :=
        Finset.measurableSet_biUnion u fun i _ ↦ hs i
      have hdisj' : Disjoint (s a) (⋃ i ∈ u, s i) := by
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro i
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro hi
        exact hdisj (Finset.mem_insert_self a u) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) fun hai ↦
            hau (hai ▸ hi)
      have hinsert : (⋃ i ∈ insert a u, s i) = s a ∪ ⋃ i ∈ u, s i := by
        ext x
        simp
      simp only [hinsert, Finset.sum_insert hau]
      rw [indicatorProjection_union mu ha hu hdisj']
      rw [ih (by
        intro i hi j hj hij
        exact hdisj (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij)]

private def partialUnion (s : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) : Set X :=
  ⋃ i ∈ Finset.range n, s i

private def unionTail (s : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) : Set X :=
  (⋃ i, s i) \ partialUnion s n

private theorem measurableSet_partialUnion (s : ℕ → Set X) (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n))
    (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (partialUnion s n) :=
  Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun i _ ↦ hs i

private theorem measurableSet_unionTail (s : ℕ → Set X) (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n))
    (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (unionTail s n) :=
  (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs).diff (measurableSet_partialUnion s hs n)

omit [MeasurableSpace X] in
private theorem antitone_unionTail (s : ℕ → Set X) : Antitone (unionTail s) := by
  intro m n hmn
  apply Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_right
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
  exact Set.mem_iUnion₂_of_mem (Finset.mem_range.2 ((Finset.mem_range.1 hi).trans_le hmn)) hxi

omit [MeasurableSpace X] in
private theorem iInter_unionTail (s : ℕ → Set X) :
    ⋂ n, unionTail s n = ∅ := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxall := Set.mem_iInter.mp hx
    have hxU : x ∈ ⋃ i, s i := (hxall 0).1
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU
    have hxtail := hxall (i + 1)
    exact hxtail.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂_of_mem (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self i)) hxi)
  · simp

private theorem norm_sq_indicatorProjection (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (f : Lp ℂ 2 mu) :
    ‖indicatorProjection mu s hs f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x in s, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂mu := by
  rw [norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ), L2.inner_def (𝕜 := ℂ)]
  rw [← integral_re (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (indicatorProjection mu s hs f)
    (indicatorProjection mu s hs f))]
  rw [← integral_indicator hs]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs f] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;>
    simp [hxs, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re]

private theorem tendsto_indicatorProjection_partialUnion
    (s : ℕ → Set X) (hs : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (f : Lp ℂ 2 mu) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ indicatorProjection mu (partialUnion s n)
      (measurableSet_partialUnion s hs n) f) atTop
      (𝓝 (indicatorProjection mu (⋃ n, s n) (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs) f)) := by
  let U : Set X := ⋃ n, s n
  let t : ℕ → Set X := unionTail s
  have htmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (t n) := measurableSet_unionTail s hs
  have hanti : Antitone t := antitone_unionTail s
  have hfint : Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ ^ 2) mu :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).aestronglyMeasurable).1 (Lp.memLp f)
  have hint := hanti.tendsto_setIntegral htmeas hfint.integrableOn
  rw [iInter_unionTail, setIntegral_empty] at hint
  have hnormsq : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ ‖indicatorProjection mu (t n) (htmeas n) f‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [norm_sq_indicatorProjection] using hint
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ‖indicatorProjection mu (t n) (htmeas n) f‖)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hsqrt := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hnormsq
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero] using hsqrt
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  convert hnorm using 1
  funext n
  rw [norm_sub_rev]
  congr 1
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorProjection_apply mu U (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs) f,
    indicatorProjection_apply mu (partialUnion s n) (measurableSet_partialUnion s hs n) f,
    indicatorProjection_apply mu (t n) (htmeas n) f,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (indicatorProjection mu U (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs) f)
      (indicatorProjection mu (partialUnion s n) (measurableSet_partialUnion s hs n) f)]
      with x hU hpartial htail hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hU, hpartial, htail]
  by_cases hxp : x ∈ partialUnion s n
  · have hxU : x ∈ U := by
      obtain ⟨i, _hi, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxp
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem i hxi
    simp [U, t, unionTail, hxU, hxp]
  · by_cases hxU : x ∈ U <;> simp [U, t, unionTail, hxU, hxp]

/-- The indicator-multiplication PVM on `L²(μ)`. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def indicatorPVM : ProjectionValuedMeasure X (Lp ℂ 2 mu) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun s ↦ if hs : MeasurableSet s then indicatorProjection mu s hs else 0
      not_measurable' := by
        intro s hs
        simp [hs]
      projection' := by
        intro s hs
        simpa [hs] using indicatorProjection_isStarProjection mu s hs
      empty' := by simp
      univ' := by simp
      inter' := by
        intro s hs t ht
        simp only [hs, ht, hs.inter ht, dite_true]
        exact indicatorProjection_inter mu s t hs ht
      m_iUnion' := by
        intro s hs hdisj f
        let P : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 mu →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 mu :=
          fun n ↦ indicatorProjection mu (s n) (hs n)
        have hP (n : ℕ) : IsStarProjection (P n) := indicatorProjection_isStarProjection mu _ _
        have horth : Pairwise fun i j ↦ P i * P j = 0 := by
          intro i j hij
          simpa only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (hdisj hij),
            indicatorProjection_empty] using
            (indicatorProjection_inter mu (s i) (s j) (hs i) (hs j)).symm
        obtain ⟨Q, _hQproj, hQsum, _hQrange⟩ :=
          exists_hasSum_of_pairwise_orthogonal P hP horth
        have hseqQ := (hQsum f).tendsto_sum_nat
        have hseqUnion := tendsto_indicatorProjection_partialUnion mu s hs f
        have hQeq : Q f = indicatorProjection mu (⋃ n, s n) (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs) f :=
          tendsto_nhds_unique hseqQ <| by
            convert hseqUnion using 1
            funext n
            have hfinite := congrArg (fun T : Lp ℂ 2 mu →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 mu ↦ T f)
              (indicatorProjection_biUnion_finset mu (Finset.range n) s hs (by
                intro i hi j hj hij
                exact hdisj hij)).symm
            simpa only [sum_apply, P, partialUnion] using hfinite
        rw [show (if _h : MeasurableSet (⋃ n, s n) then
            indicatorProjection mu (⋃ n, s n) _h else 0) =
            indicatorProjection mu (⋃ n, s n) (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs) by
          rw [dite_eq_left (MeasurableSet.iUnion hs)]]
        rw [← hQeq]
        simpa only [P, hs, dite_true] using hQsum f }

/-- Measurable-set action of the multiplication PVM. -/
theorem indicatorPVM_apply {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (f : Lp ℂ 2 mu) :
    indicatorPVM mu s f =ᵐ[mu] s.indicator fun x ↦ f x := by
  classical
  rw [indicatorPVM]
  change (if h : MeasurableSet s then indicatorProjection mu s h else 0) f =ᵐ[mu]
    s.indicator fun x ↦ f x
  rw [dite_eq_left hs]
  exact indicatorProjection_apply mu s hs f

/-- The range of a measurable value of the multiplication PVM is the supported-function
submodule. -/
theorem range_indicatorPVM {s : Set X} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    LinearMap.range (indicatorPVM mu s).toLinearMap = indicatorRange mu s := by
  classical
  rw [indicatorPVM]
  change LinearMap.range
    (if h : MeasurableSet s then indicatorProjection mu s h else 0).toLinearMap =
      indicatorRange mu s
  rw [dite_eq_left hs]
  exact range_indicatorProjection mu s hs

end ProjectionValuedMeasure

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Module

/-!
# Strong orthogonal sums identified by original scalar coefficients

This strict helper serves the actual computed normal-CFC PVM strong
countable-additivity field. Orthogonal star projections have a strong sum
by the existing projection theorem; scalar coefficient HasSum uniqueness
identifies its limit on the same original Hilbert space. No new norm,
separability, nontriviality or PVM model is installed.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure
universe uH
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Actual orthogonal projection sums converge strongly to the bounded operator
whose original inner coefficients have the same sums. -/
theorem hasSum_of_orthogonal_of_inner_hasSum
    (P : ℕ → H →L[ℂ] H) (hP : ∀ n, IsStarProjection (P n))
    (horth : Pairwise fun i j => P i * P j = 0) (L : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hcoeff : ∀ g h : H, HasSum (fun n => ⟪h, P n g⟫_ℂ) ⟪h, L g⟫_ℂ) :
    ∀ g : H, HasSum (fun n => P n g) (L g) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, _hQ, hsum, _hRange⟩ := exists_hasSum_of_pairwise_orthogonal P hP horth
  have heq : Q = L := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro g
    apply ext_inner_left ℂ
    intro h
    have hm := (hsum g).mapL (innerSL ℂ h)
    exact hm.unique (hcoeff g h)
  rw [← heq]
  exact hsum

end MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProjectionValuedMeasure

end
