module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Fredholm.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Defs
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Prod
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Cofinite
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Prod
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Complement
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.PiProd
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Restrict
public import Mathlib.Topology.Maps.Strict.Module

/-!
# Cartesian products of strong Fredholm maps

Construct all five fields of the existing strong Fredholm predicate for the
ordinary product map. The scalar is a `NontriviallyNormedField`, with its
actual norm, but neither scalar nor stage completeness is assumed.
Stages need only their topological additive/module structures; the two
source topological-add-group assumptions support the strict product lemma.
No stage norm, output model or independently supplied product projection is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Topology

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

universe u𝕜 uE₀ uE₁ uF₀ uF₁

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {E₀ : Type uE₀} {E₁ : Type uE₁} {F₀ : Type uF₀} {F₁ : Type uF₁}
variable [AddCommGroup E₀] [Module 𝕜 E₀] [TopologicalSpace E₀]
variable [AddCommGroup E₁] [Module 𝕜 E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₁]
variable [AddCommGroup F₀] [Module 𝕜 F₀] [TopologicalSpace F₀]
variable [AddCommGroup F₁] [Module 𝕜 F₁] [TopologicalSpace F₁]
variable [IsTopologicalAddGroup E₀] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E₁]

/-- The Cartesian product of two strong Fredholm maps is strong Fredholm.
No completeness of the scalar field or either source/target stage is required. -/
theorem IsFredholm.prodMap {S : E₀ →L[𝕜] F₀} {T : E₁ →L[𝕜] F₁}
    (hS : S.IsFredholm) (hT : T.IsFredholm) : (S.prodMap T).IsFredholm := by
  let U := S.prodMap T
  have hKer : U.ker = S.ker.prod T.ker := by
    change (S.toLinearMap.prodMap T.toLinearMap).ker =
      S.toLinearMap.ker.prod T.toLinearMap.ker
    exact LinearMap.ker_prodMap _ _
  have hRange : U.range = S.range.prod T.range := by
    change (S.toLinearMap.prodMap T.toLinearMap).range =
      S.toLinearMap.range.prod T.toLinearMap.range
    exact LinearMap.range_prodMap _ _
  change U.IsFredholm
  refine
    { isStrictMap := ?_
      isClosed_range := ?_
      finite_ker := ?_
      finite_coker := ?_
      closedComplemented_ker := ?_ }
  · change IsStrictMap (S.toLinearMap.prodMap T.toLinearMap)
    exact LinearMap.isStrictMap_prodMap hS.isStrictMap hT.isStrictMap
  · rw [hRange]
    change IsClosed (Set.prod (S.range : Set F₀) (T.range : Set F₁))
    exact hS.isClosed_range.prod hT.isClosed_range
  · rw [hKer]
    apply (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mp
    exact ((Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional S.ker).mpr hS.finite_ker).prod
      ((Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional T.ker).mpr hT.finite_ker)
  · let : Module.Finite 𝕜 (F₀ ⧸ S.range) := hS.finite_coker
    let : Module.Finite 𝕜 (F₁ ⧸ T.range) := hT.finite_coker
    let q : F₀ × F₁ →ₗ[𝕜] (F₀ ⧸ S.range) × (F₁ ⧸ T.range) :=
      S.range.mkQ.prodMap T.range.mkQ
    have hq : q.ker = U.range := by
      calc
        q.ker = S.range.prod T.range := by
          change (S.range.mkQ.prodMap T.range.mkQ).ker = S.range.prod T.range
          simp only [LinearMap.ker_prodMap, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
        _ = U.range := hRange.symm
    have hCoFG : q.ker.CoFG := Submodule.CoFG.ker q
    rw [hq] at hCoFG
    exact hCoFG
  · obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := hS.closedComplemented_ker
    obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁⟩ := hT.closedComplemented_ker
    let r : E₀ × E₁ →L[𝕜] E₀ × E₁ :=
      (S.ker.subtypeL.comp P₀).prodMap (T.ker.subtypeL.comp P₁)
    have hr (x : E₀ × E₁) : r x ∈ U.ker := by
      rw [hKer]
      change (P₀ x.1 : E₀) ∈ S.ker ∧ (P₁ x.2 : E₁) ∈ T.ker
      exact ⟨(P₀ x.1).2, (P₁ x.2).2⟩
    refine ⟨r.codRestrict U.ker hr, ?_⟩
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change r x.1 = x.1
    have hx : x.1.1 ∈ S.ker ∧ x.1.2 ∈ T.ker := by
      have hmem : x.1 ∈ S.ker.prod T.ker :=
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun K : Submodule 𝕜 (E₀ × E₁) => x.1 ∈ K) hKer) x.2
      exact hmem
    apply Prod.ext
    · change (P₀ x.1.1 : E₀) = x.1.1
      exact congrArg (fun y : S.ker => (y : E₀)) (hP₀ ⟨x.1.1, hx.1⟩)
    · change (P₁ x.1.2 : E₁) = x.1.2
      exact congrArg (fun y : T.ker => (y : E₁)) (hP₁ ⟨x.1.2, hx.2⟩)

end ContinuousLinearMap

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Fredholm.CompactParametrix
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.FiniteRange
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.Lemmas
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Idempotent

import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Fredholm compression between idempotent ranges

A Fredholm map between independent complete real or complex Hilbert spaces
remains Fredholm after compression by bounded idempotents whose intertwining
defect is compact. The actual range submodules retain their inherited norms,
topologies and inner products. Neither orthogonality nor cofiniteness of the
supports is required, and the target idempotent need not preserve the raw image.
No equality between the ambient and compressed indices is asserted.
-/

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

universe u𝕜 uE uF

section DefectIdentities

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [Ring 𝕜]
variable {E : Type uE} [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]
  [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E]
variable {F : Type uF} [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 F]
  [TopologicalSpace F] [IsTopologicalAddGroup F]

private theorem range_compression_left_defect
    {p : E →L[𝕜] E} {q : F →L[𝕜] F} {T : E →L[𝕜] F} {U : F →L[𝕜] E}
    (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) :
    (p.rangeRestrict.comp (U.domRestrict q.range)).comp
        (q.rangeRestrict.comp (T.domRestrict p.range)) - (1 : p.range →L[𝕜] p.range) =
      p.rangeRestrict.comp
        (((U.comp T - 1) - U.comp (T.comp p - q.comp T)).domRestrict p.range) := by
  have hpFix (x : p.range) : p (x : E) = (x : E) :=
    (LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isProj_range p.toLinearMap
      (ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.toLinearMap hp)).map_id (x : E) x.property
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change p (U (q (T (x : E)))) - (x : E) =
    p ((U (T (x : E)) - (x : E)) - U (T (p (x : E)) - q (T (x : E))))
  rw [hpFix x, map_sub U]
  simp only [map_sub, hpFix x]
  abel

omit [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] in
private theorem range_compression_right_defect
    {p : E →L[𝕜] E} {q : F →L[𝕜] F} {T : E →L[𝕜] F} {U : F →L[𝕜] E}
    (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) :
    (q.rangeRestrict.comp (T.domRestrict p.range)).comp
        (p.rangeRestrict.comp (U.domRestrict q.range)) - (1 : q.range →L[𝕜] q.range) =
      q.rangeRestrict.comp
        (((T.comp U - 1) + (T.comp p - q.comp T).comp U).domRestrict q.range) := by
  have hqFix (y : q.range) : q (y : F) = (y : F) :=
    (LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isProj_range q.toLinearMap
      (ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.toLinearMap hq)).map_id (y : F) y.property
  have hqq (y : F) : q (q y) = q y :=
    hqFix (⟨q y, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩ : q.range)
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro y
  apply Subtype.ext
  change q (T (p (U (y : F)))) - (y : F) =
    q ((T (U (y : F)) - (y : F)) + (T (p (U (y : F))) - q (T (U (y : F)))))
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, hqFix y, hqq]
  abel

end DefectIdentities

@[expose] public section

open scoped LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid

namespace IsFredholm

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
  [CompleteSpace E]
variable {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F]
  [CompleteSpace F]

/-- A Fredholm map compresses to a Fredholm map between the actual ranges of
bounded idempotents when its intertwining defect is compact. The idempotents
need not be orthogonal, their ranges need not be cofinite, and no equality
between the ambient and compressed indices is implied. -/
theorem range_compression {p : E →L[𝕜] E} {q : F →L[𝕜] F} {T : E →L[𝕜] F}
    (hT : T.IsFredholm) (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) (hq : IsIdempotentElem q)
    (hDelta : IsCompactOperator (T.comp p - q.comp T)) :
    (q.rangeRestrict.comp (T.domRestrict p.range)).IsFredholm := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hT.exists_isQuasiInverse
  let A : E →L[𝕜] E := U.comp T - 1
  let B : F →L[𝕜] F := T.comp U - 1
  have hAfin : A.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    have hLeft : U.toLinearMap.IsLeftQuasiInverse T.toLinearMap := hU.1
    rw [LinearMap.IsLeftQuasiInverse,
      LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange] at hLeft
    change A.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange at hLeft
    exact hLeft
  have hBfin : B.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    have hRight : U.toLinearMap.IsRightQuasiInverse T.toLinearMap := hU.2
    rw [LinearMap.IsRightQuasiInverse,
      LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange] at hRight
    change B.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange at hRight
    exact hRight
  have hA : IsCompactOperator A :=
    LinearMap.HasFiniteRange.isCompactOperator (T := A) hAfin
  have hB : IsCompactOperator B :=
    LinearMap.HasFiniteRange.isCompactOperator (T := B) hBfin
  let D : E →L[𝕜] F := T.comp p - q.comp T
  have hD : IsCompactOperator D := hDelta
  have hUD : IsCompactOperator (U.comp D) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using hD.clm_comp U
  have hDU : IsCompactOperator (D.comp U) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using hD.comp_clm U
  let CE : E →L[𝕜] E := A - U.comp D
  let CF : F →L[𝕜] F := B + D.comp U
  have hCE : IsCompactOperator CE := by
    simpa only [CE, FunLike.coe_sub] using hA.sub hUD
  have hCF : IsCompactOperator CF := by
    simpa only [CF, FunLike.coe_add] using hB.add hDU
  let S : p.range →L[𝕜] q.range := q.rangeRestrict.comp (T.domRestrict p.range)
  let V : q.range →L[𝕜] p.range := p.rangeRestrict.comp (U.domRestrict q.range)
  have hLeftDefect : V.comp S - 1 =
      p.rangeRestrict.comp (CE.domRestrict p.range) :=
    range_compression_left_defect (p := p) (q := q) (T := T) (U := U) hp
  have hRightDefect : S.comp V - 1 =
      q.rangeRestrict.comp (CF.domRestrict q.range) :=
    range_compression_right_defect (p := p) (q := q) (T := T) (U := U) hq
  have hCEdom : IsCompactOperator (CE.domRestrict p.range) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.domRestrict, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
      using hCE.comp_clm p.range.subtypeL
  have hCFdom : IsCompactOperator (CF.domRestrict q.range) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.domRestrict, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
      using hCF.comp_clm q.range.subtypeL
  have hLeft : IsCompactOperator (V.comp S - (1 : p.range →L[𝕜] p.range)) := by
    rw [hLeftDefect]
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using hCEdom.clm_comp p.rangeRestrict
  have hRight : IsCompactOperator (S.comp V - (1 : q.range →L[𝕜] q.range)) := by
    rw [hRightDefect]
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using hCFdom.clm_comp q.rangeRestrict
  let : CompleteSpace p.range :=
    IsClosed.completeSpace_coe (s := (p.range : Set E))
      (hs := ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isClosed_range hp)
  let : CompleteSpace q.range :=
    IsClosed.completeSpace_coe (s := (q.range : Set F))
      (hs := ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isClosed_range hq)
  exact of_compactParametrix S V hLeft hRight

end IsFredholm

end

end ContinuousLinearMap

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Map

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic

/-!
# Strong Fredholm transport along actual continuous linear equivalences

The operator is the literal rectangular transport `c⁻¹ ∘ V ∘ d`.
All four stages have independent universes and actual group/topology/module
parents. The scalar remains a `NontriviallyNormedField`; this is not a
wholly norm-free API. No stage norm, scalar/stage completeness, stage separation
or supplied output equivalence/kernel model is required.
All five strong fields are transported through genuine maps and retractions.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Topology

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

universe u𝕜 uD uE uC uF

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {D : Type uD} {E : Type uE} {C : Type uC} {F : Type uF}
variable [AddCommGroup D] [Module 𝕜 D] [TopologicalSpace D]
variable [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace E]
variable [AddCommGroup C] [Module 𝕜 C] [TopologicalSpace C]
variable [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 F] [TopologicalSpace F]

/-- Transport a strong Fredholm map by actual source and target equivalences.
The scalar is normed; no stage norm, scalar/stage completeness or stage `T2Space` is required. -/
theorem IsFredholm.transport {V : E →L[𝕜] F} (hV : V.IsFredholm)
    (d : D ≃L[𝕜] E) (c : C ≃L[𝕜] F) :
    (c.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (V.comp d.toContinuousLinearMap)).IsFredholm := by
  let U := c.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (V.comp d.toContinuousLinearMap)
  have hKerComap : U.ker = V.ker.comap d.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    change c.symm (V (d x)) = 0 ↔ V (d x) = 0
    exact c.symm.map_eq_zero_iff
  have hKerMap : U.ker = V.ker.map d.symm.toLinearMap := by
    rw [hKerComap]
    exact Submodule.comap_equiv_eq_map_symm d.toLinearEquiv V.ker
  have hRangeComap : U.range = V.range.comap c.toLinearMap := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change c (c.symm (V (d x))) ∈ V.range
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact ⟨d x, rfl⟩
    · intro hy
      change c y ∈ V.range at hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy
      change V x = c y at hx
      refine ⟨d.symm x, ?_⟩
      change c.symm (V (d (d.symm x))) = y
      rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hx,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hRangeMap : U.range = V.range.map c.symm.toLinearMap := by
    rw [hRangeComap]
    exact Submodule.comap_equiv_eq_map_symm c.toLinearEquiv V.range
  change U.IsFredholm
  refine
    { isStrictMap := ?_
      isClosed_range := ?_
      finite_ker := ?_
      finite_coker := ?_
      closedComplemented_ker := ?_ }
  · change IsStrictMap (c.symm ∘ V ∘ d)
    apply c.symm.toHomeomorph.comp_isStrictMap_iff.mpr
    exact d.toHomeomorph.isStrictMap_comp_iff.mpr hV.isStrictMap
  · rw [hRangeMap]
    change IsClosed (c.symm '' (V.range : Set F))
    exact c.symm.toHomeomorph.isClosed_image.mpr hV.isClosed_range
  · rw [hKerMap]
    apply (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mp
    exact ((Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional V.ker).mpr hV.finite_ker).map
      d.symm.toLinearMap
  · let : Module.Finite 𝕜 (F ⧸ V.range) := hV.finite_coker
    let q : C →ₗ[𝕜] F ⧸ V.range := V.range.mkQ.comp c.toLinearMap
    have hq : q.ker = U.range := by
      calc
        q.ker = V.range.comap c.toLinearMap := by
          change (V.range.mkQ.comp c.toLinearMap).ker = V.range.comap c.toLinearMap
          rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
        _ = U.range := hRangeComap.symm
    have hCoFG : q.ker.CoFG := Submodule.CoFG.ker q
    rw [hq] at hCoFG
    exact hCoFG
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hV.closedComplemented_ker
    let r : D →L[𝕜] D :=
      d.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        ((V.ker.subtypeL.comp p).comp d.toContinuousLinearMap)
    have hr (x : D) : r x ∈ U.ker := by
      rw [hKerComap]
      change d (d.symm (p (d x) : E)) ∈ V.ker
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using (p (d x)).2
    refine ⟨r.codRestrict U.ker hr, ?_⟩
    intro x
    have hx : d x.1 ∈ V.ker := by
      have hmem : x.1 ∈ V.ker.comap d.toLinearMap :=
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun K : Submodule 𝕜 D => x.1 ∈ K) hKerComap) x.2
      exact hmem
    have hfix : (p (d x.1) : E) = d x.1 :=
      congrArg (fun y : V.ker => (y : E)) (hp ⟨d x.1, hx⟩)
    apply Subtype.ext
    change d.symm (p (d x.1) : E) = x.1
    rw [hfix]
    exact d.symm_apply_apply x.1

end ContinuousLinearMap

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpSpace
public import Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.WithSeminorms
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay
public import Mathlib.Analysis.PSeries
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.UniformFilterBasis

/-!
# Rapidly decreasing sequences with their weighted supremum topology

`RapidSequence 𝕜 E` consists of sequences for which every polynomially weighted
sequence belongs to the native space `lp (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞`. Its topology is
generated by the supremum norms of these weighted sequences, rather than by
coordinatewise convergence. The positive weight `(n + 1) ^ k` also controls
coordinate zero.

The scalar field is real or complex. This is a small sequence-space prerequisite
for Fourier interpolation; it does not construct interpolation kernels or bases.

The topology uses Mathlib's `SeminormFamily.moduleFilterBasis`, also used by
`SchwartzMap`. The sequence carrier and weighted maps are separate from the
smooth-function carrier `SchwartzMap`.
-/

@[expose] public noncomputable section

open scoped ENNReal Topology

variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]

/-- Mathlib's superpolynomial decay predicate for the norms is equivalent to
boundedness of every polynomial weight in native `ℓ∞`. -/
theorem Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_norm_iff_memℓp_infty (f : ℕ → E) :
    Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖) ↔
      ∀ k : ℕ, Memℓp (fun n ↦ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n) ∞ := by
  have hk : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hnorm (k n : ℕ) : ‖(((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n‖ =
      |((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖f n‖| := by
    rw [norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_iff_abs_isBoundedUnder _ hk]
  constructor
  · intro h k
    apply memℓp_infty
    simpa only [hnorm] using (h k).bddAbove_range
  · intro h k
    have hb := (h k).bddAbove
    simp only [hnorm] at hb
    exact hb.isBoundedUnder_of_range

/-- The usual weight `n` and the positive weight `n + 1` give the same rapid decay
predicate, including the harmless finite head at coordinate zero. -/
theorem Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_natCast_add_one_iff (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)) f ↔
    Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) f := by
  constructor
  · intro h k
    have hp := (h.polynomial_mul ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C 1) ^ k)) 0
    simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hp
  · intro h k
    have hp := (h.polynomial_mul ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 1) ^ k)) 0
    simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right] using hp

/-- The submodule of rapidly decreasing sequences, before specifying its topology. -/
def rapidSequenceSubmodule (𝕜 E : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] : Submodule 𝕜 (ℕ → E) where
  carrier := {f | ∀ k : ℕ, Memℓp (fun n ↦ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n) ∞}
  zero_mem' k := by
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero] using
      (zero_mem_ℓp' (E := fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) (p := ∞))
  add_mem' hf hg k := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_def, smul_add] using (hf k).add (hg k)
  smul_mem' c f hf k := by
    convert (hf k).const_smul c using 1
    ext n
    exact smul_comm _ _ _

/-- Rapidly decreasing sequences, equipped below with the weighted supremum topology.

This type synonym keeps the inherited pointwise topology of the ambient function
space out of the public instance interface.
-/
def RapidSequence (𝕜 E : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] : Type _ := ↥(rapidSequenceSubmodule 𝕜 E)

namespace RapidSequence

instance : FunLike (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) ℕ E where
  coe f := f.1
  coe_injective _ _ h := Subtype.ext h

instance : AddCommGroup (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (rapidSequenceSubmodule 𝕜 E))

instance : Module 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module 𝕜 (rapidSequenceSubmodule 𝕜 E))

@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : RapidSequence 𝕜 E} (h : ∀ n, f n = g n) : f = g :=
  DFunLike.ext f g h

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (n : ℕ) : (0 : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) n = 0 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem add_apply (f g : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (n : ℕ) : (f + g) n = f n + g n := rfl

@[simp]
theorem neg_apply (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (n : ℕ) : (-f) n = -f n := rfl

@[simp]
theorem sub_apply (f g : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (n : ℕ) : (f - g) n = f n - g n := rfl

@[simp]
theorem smul_apply (c : 𝕜) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (n : ℕ) : (c • f) n = c • f n := rfl

/-- Construct a rapid sequence from Mathlib's superpolynomial decay predicate. -/
def ofFunction (f : ℕ → E) (hf : Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖)) : RapidSequence 𝕜 E :=
  ⟨f, (Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_norm_iff_memℓp_infty (𝕜 := 𝕜) f).mp hf⟩

@[simp]
theorem ofFunction_apply (f : ℕ → E) (hf : Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖)) (n : ℕ) :
    ofFunction (𝕜 := 𝕜) f hf n = f n := rfl

/-- Every rapid sequence has superpolynomially decaying norms. -/
theorem decay (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) : Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖) :=
  (Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_norm_iff_memℓp_infty (𝕜 := 𝕜) f).mpr f.2

/-- The native decay predicate with the usual weight `n`. -/
theorem decay_natCast (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) : Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)) (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖) :=
  (Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_natCast_add_one_iff (fun n ↦ ‖f n‖)).mpr f.decay

/-- Every polynomially weighted sequence tends to zero. -/
theorem tendsto_weighted (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (k : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast] using f.decay k

/-- The conventional weights `n ^ k` also tend to zero. -/
theorem tendsto_natCast_pow_smul (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (k : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : 𝕜) ^ k • f n) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast] using f.decay_natCast k

/-- Polynomially weighted norms of a rapid sequence are summable. -/
theorem summable_weight_mul_norm (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (k : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖f n‖) := by
  have hd := f.decay_natCast.polynomial_mul ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C 1) ^ k)
  have ho := (Asymptotics.superpolynomialDecay_iff_isBigO _
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).mp hd (-2)
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) := by
    simpa only [zpow_neg, zpow_ofNat] using (Real.summable_nat_pow_inv (p := 2)).mpr (by decide)
  simpa only [Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using summable_of_isBigO_nat hs ho

/-- A sequence supported at a single coordinate. -/
def single (n : ℕ) (x : E) : RapidSequence 𝕜 E :=
  ⟨Pi.single n x, by
    intro k
    convert lp.memℓp (lp.single (E := fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞ n ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • x)) using 1
    ext m
    by_cases hm : m = n
    · subst m
      simp only [lp.single_apply, Pi.single_eq_same]
    · simp only [lp.single_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hm, smul_zero]⟩

@[simp]
theorem single_apply_self (n : ℕ) (x : E) : single (𝕜 := 𝕜) n x n = x :=
  Pi.single_eq_same _ _

theorem single_apply_ne (n : ℕ) (x : E) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ n) : single (𝕜 := 𝕜) n x m = 0 :=
  Pi.single_eq_of_ne hm _

/-- Multiplication by a polynomial weight as a map into native `ℓ∞`. -/
def weightedLM (k : ℕ) : RapidSequence 𝕜 E →ₗ[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞ where
  toFun f := ⟨fun n ↦ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n, f.2 k⟩
  map_add' f g := by
    ext n
    exact smul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c f := by
    ext n
    exact smul_comm _ _ _

@[simp]
theorem weightedLM_apply (k n : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    weightedLM k f n = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n := rfl

/-- The `k`th weighted supremum seminorm. -/
def seminorm (k : ℕ) : Seminorm 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (normSeminorm 𝕜 (lp (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞)).comp (weightedLM k)

theorem seminorm_eq_norm (k : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    seminorm k f = ‖weightedLM k f‖ := rfl

/-- The seminorm is the genuine supremum over all coordinates. -/
theorem seminorm_eq_iSup (k : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    seminorm k f = ⨆ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖f n‖ := by
  rw [seminorm_eq_norm, lp.norm_eq_ciSup]
  simp only [weightedLM_apply, norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast]

theorem weight_mul_norm_le_seminorm (k n : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖f n‖ ≤ seminorm k f := by
  simpa only [seminorm_eq_norm, weightedLM_apply, norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast] using
    lp.norm_apply_le_norm ENNReal.top_ne_zero (weightedLM k f) n

theorem seminorm_le_of_forall_le (k : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : ∀ n, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖f n‖ ≤ C) :
    seminorm k f ≤ C := by
  apply lp.norm_le_of_forall_le hC
  simpa only [weightedLM_apply, norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast] using hf

theorem norm_apply_le_seminorm_zero (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖f n‖ ≤ seminorm 0 f := by
  simpa using weight_mul_norm_le_seminorm 0 n f

/-- The countable family defining the topology. -/
def seminormFamily : SeminormFamily 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) ℕ := seminorm

instance : TopologicalSpace (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).moduleFilterBasis.topology'

theorem withSeminorms : WithSeminorms (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) := ⟨rfl⟩

instance : IsTopologicalAddGroup (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).addGroupFilterBasis.isTopologicalAddGroup

instance : ContinuousSMul 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).moduleFilterBasis.continuousSMul

instance : UniformSpace (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).addGroupFilterBasis.uniformSpace

instance : IsUniformAddGroup (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (seminormFamily (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).addGroupFilterBasis.isUniformAddGroup

instance : PolynormableSpace 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) := withSeminorms.toPolynormableSpace

/-- The weighted seminorm topology is locally convex for the compatible real scalar action. -/
instance instLocallyConvexSpace [Module ℝ (RapidSequence 𝕜 E)]
    [IsScalarTower ℝ 𝕜 (RapidSequence 𝕜 E)] : LocallyConvexSpace ℝ (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :=
  (withSeminorms (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).toLocallyConvexSpace

instance : FirstCountableTopology (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) := withSeminorms.firstCountableTopology

instance : T1Space (RapidSequence 𝕜 E) := by
  apply withSeminorms.T1_of_separating
  intro f hf
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro h
  apply hf
  ext n
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  exact le_antisymm (h ▸ norm_apply_le_seminorm_zero f n) (norm_nonneg _)

/-- Each weighted `ℓ∞` map is continuous for the rapid-sequence topology. -/
def weightedCLM (k : ℕ) : RapidSequence 𝕜 E →L[𝕜] lp (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞ where
  toLinearMap := weightedLM k
  cont := by
    change Continuous (weightedLM (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) k)
    exact WithSeminorms.continuous_normedSpace_rng (lp (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞)
      (withSeminorms (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (weightedLM (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) k)
      ⟨{k}, 1, by simp [seminormFamily, seminorm]⟩

@[simp]
theorem weightedCLM_apply (k n : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    weightedCLM k f n = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • f n := rfl

theorem seminorm_eq_norm_weightedCLM (k : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) :
    seminorm k f = ‖weightedCLM k f‖ := rfl

/-- A singleton has the expected weighted supremum seminorm, including at index zero. -/
theorem seminorm_single (k n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    seminorm k (single (𝕜 := 𝕜) n x) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * ‖x‖ := by
  have h : weightedLM k (single (𝕜 := 𝕜) n x) =
      lp.single ∞ n ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ k) • x) := by
    ext m
    by_cases hm : m = n
    · subst m
      simp only [weightedLM_apply, single_apply_self, lp.single_apply_self]
    · simp only [weightedLM_apply, single_apply_ne _ _ hm, lp.single_apply_ne _ _ _ hm, smul_zero]
  rw [seminorm_eq_norm, h, lp.norm_single (by simp)]
  simp only [norm_smul, norm_pow, RCLike.norm_natCast]

/-- Evaluation is continuous and linear, with bound given by the zeroth seminorm. -/
def evalCLM (n : ℕ) : RapidSequence 𝕜 E →L[𝕜] E :=
  (lp.evalCLM 𝕜 (fun _ : ℕ ↦ E) ∞ n).comp (weightedCLM 0)

@[simp]
theorem evalCLM_apply (n : ℕ) (f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E) : evalCLM n f = f n := by
  change (((n + 1 : ℕ) : 𝕜) ^ 0) • f n = f n
  simp

/-- Convergence is simultaneous uniform convergence for every polynomial weight. -/
theorem tendsto_iff {α : Type*} {u : α → RapidSequence 𝕜 E} {l : Filter α}
    {f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E} : Filter.Tendsto u l (𝓝 f) ↔
    ∀ k ε, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ a in l, seminorm k (u a - f) < ε :=
  withSeminorms.tendsto_nhds u f

/-- The topology is initial with respect to the family of weighted `ℓ∞` maps. -/
theorem tendsto_iff_weighted {α : Type*} {u : α → RapidSequence 𝕜 E} {l : Filter α}
    {f : RapidSequence 𝕜 E} : Filter.Tendsto u l (𝓝 f) ↔
    ∀ k, Filter.Tendsto (fun a ↦ weightedCLM k (u a)) l (𝓝 (weightedCLM k f)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h k
    exact (weightedCLM k).continuous.tendsto _ |>.comp h
  · intro h
    rw [tendsto_iff]
    intro k ε hε
    have hw := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (h k) ε hε
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, seminorm_eq_norm_weightedCLM] using hw

end RapidSequence

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Mul
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear

/-!
# The actual predual pullback of fixed star conjugation

The stock bounded left/right multiplication map sends a to star x * a * x.
Its functional pullback sends each original vector coefficient to the
coefficient with both vectors multiplied by the same x. The actual closed
normal-functional span is therefore invariant. Restricting the stock
functional pullback constructs the continuous linear map on that predual.

This proves ultraweak continuity of the same literal conjugation map.
It supplies the normal-conjugation prerequisite for the original bounded
positive LUB/weight-normality construction. It does not identify positive
LUBs with ultraweak limits or supply a normal weight/GNS representation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Fixed literal star conjugation has its actual bounded pullback on the original normal predual. -/
def normalFunctionalConjugationPullback (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M) :
    normalFunctionalSpace M →L[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  let C : M →L[ℂ] M := ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℂ M (star x) x
  let B : StrongDual ℂ M →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M M ℂ).flip C
  let P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M) := (normalFunctionalSpace M).comap B.toLinearMap
  have hP : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
    change IsClosed (B ⁻¹' (normalFunctionalSpace M : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)))
    exact (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage B.continuous
  have hvec : ∀ ξ η : H, vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ P := by
    intro ξ η
    change B (vectorFunctional M ξ η) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M
    have hshift : B (vectorFunctional M ξ η) =
        vectorFunctional M ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro a
      change vectorFunctional M ξ η (star x * a * x) =
        vectorFunctional M ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η) a
      rw [vectorFunctional_apply, vectorFunctional_apply]
      change ⟪ξ, (star (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (a : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) η⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪(x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, (a : H →L[ℂ] H) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
      rw [mul_apply_eq_comp, mul_apply_eq_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    rw [hshift]
    exact vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M
      ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η)
  have hle : normalFunctionalSpace M ≤ P := normalFunctionalSpace_le M hP hvec
  let T := B.comp (normalFunctionalSpace M).subtypeL
  exact T.codRestrict (normalFunctionalSpace M) fun ψ => hle ψ.property

/-- The constructed predual map has exactly the original star-conjugation functional values. -/
theorem normalFunctionalConjugationPullback_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M)
    (ψ : normalFunctionalSpace M) (a : M) :
    (normalFunctionalConjugationPullback M x ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) a =
      (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (star x * a * x) :=
  rfl

/-- The same literal fixed star conjugation is continuous for the actual ultraweak topology. -/
theorem ultraweak_starConjugation_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M) :
    Continuous (fun a : Ultraweak M =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (star x * ultraweakLinearEquiv M a * x)) := by
  apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
  intro ψ
  let ψx : normalFunctionalSpace M := normalFunctionalConjugationPullback M x ψ
  have hcontinuous := ultraweak_eval_continuous M ψx
  change Continuous (fun a : Ultraweak M =>
    (normalFunctionalConjugationPullback M x ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M a)) at hcontinuous
  change Continuous (fun a : Ultraweak M =>
    (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (star x * ultraweakLinearEquiv M a * x))
  simpa only [normalFunctionalConjugationPullback_apply] using hcontinuous

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Measure.RadonProduct.Haar
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.HaarWeylAlgebra

/-!
# The diagonal Weyl algebra on full Hilbert-valued Radon product L2

The original Haar left representation of the actual product group is
restricted along the diagonal homomorphism. The character representation
uses actual character pullback along the second coordinate. These operators
generate a concrete von Neumann algebra on the full `Lp H 2 (radonProd μ μ)`
for the Borel sigma-algebra of the topological product.

All group, Hilbert and measure carriers are the original ones. The
generator unitaries retain their bounded-operator values and a.e. diagonal
translation and second-coordinate character formulas. The inverse character
uses the same original multiplier at `χ⁻¹`. There is no countability,
s-finiteness or nonzero-Hilbert-space assumption.

This construction selects no Fourier unitary, spatial shear or factor
isomorphism. Their original source identifications remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [T2Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual Borel measurable space of the original topological square. -/
local instance instDiagonalWeylProductMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (G × G) := borel (G × G)
local instance instDiagonalWeylProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (G × G) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The original product-Haar representation restricted along the actual diagonal homomorphism. -/
def diagonalHaarLeftRegular :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) where
  toMonoidHom :=
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular (G × G) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) H).toMonoidHom.comp
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.diag G).toMonoidHom
  continuous_orbit ξ :=
    ((StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular
      (G × G) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) H).continuous_orbit ξ).comp
        (ContinuousMonoidHom.diag G).continuous

/-- The diagonal representation is the unchanged original Haar operator at `(g,g)`. -/
@[simp]
theorem diagonalHaarLeftRegular_apply (g : G) :
    (diagonalHaarLeftRegular (H := H) μ g :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) =
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular
        (G × G) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) H (g, g) :
          Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :=
  rfl

/-- Both original coordinates translate by `g⁻¹` on every full product-L2 vector a.e. -/
theorem diagonalHaarLeftRegular_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalHaarLeftRegular (H := H) μ g :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
        fun z : G × G => ξ (g⁻¹ * z.1, g⁻¹ * z.2) :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq
    (G × G) (Measure.radonProd μ μ) H (g, g) ξ

/-- Pull back the actual continuous-character group along the literal second projection. -/
def secondCoordinateCharacterMap : PontryaginDual G →ₜ* PontryaginDual (G × G) :=
  PontryaginDual.map (ContinuousMonoidHom.snd G G)

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The pulled-back character is the same original character on the second coordinate. -/
@[simp]
theorem secondCoordinateCharacterMap_apply (χ : PontryaginDual G) (z : G × G) :
    secondCoordinateCharacterMap χ z = χ z.2 :=
  rfl

/-- Actual second-coordinate character multiplication on the original full Hilbert-valued square. -/
def diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation (PontryaginDual G) (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) where
  toMonoidHom :=
    (HaarL2.characterMultiplierRepresentation (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ μ)).toMonoidHom.comp
      (secondCoordinateCharacterMap (G := G)).toMonoidHom
  continuous_orbit ξ :=
    ((HaarL2.characterMultiplierRepresentation (H := H)
      (Measure.radonProd μ μ)).continuous_orbit ξ).comp
        (secondCoordinateCharacterMap (G := G)).continuous

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The character representation is the exact original multiplier at the pulled-back character. -/
@[simp]
theorem diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation_apply (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) =
        HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := H) (Measure.radonProd μ μ)
          (secondCoordinateCharacterMap χ) :=
  rfl

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The character multiplier has its original positive second-coordinate values on all vectors a.e. -/
theorem diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
        fun z : G × G => ((χ z.2 : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ z :=
  HaarL2.characterMultiplier_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (secondCoordinateCharacterMap χ) ξ

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- The actual inverse-character operator keeps the original conjugate-coordinate convention a.e. -/
theorem diagonalHaarInverseCharacterRepresentation_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ⁻¹ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
        fun z : G × G => ((χ⁻¹ z.2 : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ z :=
  diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation_ae_eq μ χ⁻¹ ξ

/-- The actual original diagonal translations and second-coordinate character operator ranges. -/
def diagonalHaarWeylGenerators :
    Set (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :=
  Set.range (fun g : G => (diagonalHaarLeftRegular (H := H) μ g :
    Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ))) ∪
    Set.range (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)))

/-- The actual diagonal Weyl algebra on the original full Hilbert-valued Radon square. -/
def diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :=
  generatedBy (diagonalHaarWeylGenerators (H := H) μ)

/-- Every original diagonal Haar unitary belongs to the same full product-L2 generated algebra. -/
theorem diagonalHaarLeftRegular_mem_diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (g : G) :
    (diagonalHaarLeftRegular (H := H) μ g :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ∈
        diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (H := H) μ :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self g))

/-- Every original second-coordinate character unitary belongs to the same generated algebra. -/
theorem diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation_mem_diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ∈
        diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (H := H) μ :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self χ))

/-- Containment of the actual diagonal Weyl algebra is precisely containment of its original operators. -/
theorem diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra_le_iff
    (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ))) :
    diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (H := H) μ ≤ N ↔
      (∀ g : G, (diagonalHaarLeftRegular (H := H) μ g :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ∈ N) ∧
      ∀ χ : PontryaginDual G, (diagonalHaarCharacterRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) ∈ N := by
  rw [diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra, generatedBy_le_iff]
  simp only [diagonalHaarWeylGenerators, Set.union_subset_iff, Set.range_subset_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

/-- The original full product-L2 diagonal Weyl carrier is closed in the actual weak operator topology. -/
theorem diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra_isClosedWOT :
    IsClosed {T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →WOT[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) |
      T.toCLM ∈ diagonalHaarWeylAlgebra (H := H) μ} :=
  generatedBy_isClosedWOT (diagonalHaarWeylGenerators (H := H) μ)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalizedNormalFunctional

/-!
# Finite original projection localizations give an actual normal functional

For each original projection and vector with the literal positive local
comparison, the strict local constructor supplies ψ(·p) in the existing
normal-functional space. Their finite sum is an actual member of the same
space and evaluates to ψ(a*∑p). No normal member or finite-cutoff norm
certificate is an input. Orthogonality and maximal-family approximation
are separate remaining prerequisites for the global normality criterion.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped BigOperators

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct the finite sum of actual local normal functionals, with its original sum-projection values. -/
def finiteLocalizedNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) {I : Type v} :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : I → M) →
      (hp : ∀ i, IsStarProjection (p i)) → (ξ : I → H) →
      (∀ i, ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) (p i) →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M (ξ i) (ξ i) (b : M)).re) →
      (s : Finset I) → {ρ : normalFunctionalSpace M // ∀ a : M,
        (ρ.val : StrongDual ℂ M) a = ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * ∑ i ∈ s, p i)} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal s
  let pieces (i : I) := localizedNormalFunctional M ψ (p i) (hp i) (ξ i) (hlocal i)
  let ρ : normalFunctionalSpace M := ∑ i ∈ s, (pieces i).val
  refine ⟨ρ, ?_⟩
  intro a
  have hvalues (i : I) : ((pieces i).val.val : StrongDual ℂ M) a =
      ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p i) := (pieces i).property a
  change ((∑ i ∈ s, (pieces i).val : normalFunctionalSpace M).val : StrongDual ℂ M) a = _
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, sum_apply, hvalues, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.FiniteLocalizedNormalFunctional
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveFunctionalProjectionResidual
public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.StarProjection.FiniteSum

/-!
# Actual finite orthogonal localizations with the original residual norm estimate

The original finite orthogonal projection sum is a genuine star projection.
The strict finite local-normal constructor supplies the original ψ(a*∑p)
values in the existing normal-functional space. The proved right-projection
residual bound controls its continuous-dual norm error. Every output field
is derived from these actual values, rather than supplied as a certificate.
The maximal projection family and global normality criterion remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped BigOperators

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct an actual finite normal approximation and its original projection-residual bound. -/
def finiteOrthogonalNormalApproximation (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) {I : Type v} :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : I → M) →
      (∀ i, IsStarProjection (p i)) →
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → p i * p j = 0) → (ξ : I → H) →
      (∀ i, ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) (p i) →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M (ξ i) (ξ i) (b : M)).re) →
      (s : Finset I) → {ρ : normalFunctionalSpace M //
        (∀ a : M, (ρ.val : StrongDual ℂ M) a =
          ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * ∑ i ∈ s, p i)) ∧
        ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap - (ρ.val : StrongDual ℂ M)‖ ≤
          Real.sqrt (‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
            ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (1 - ∑ i ∈ s, p i)‖)} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp horthogonal ξ hlocal s
  let P : M := ∑ i ∈ s, p i
  have hP : IsStarProjection P :=
    IsStarProjection.finset_sum_of_pairwise_mul_eq_zero s p
      (fun i _hi => hp i) (fun i _hi j _hj hij => horthogonal i j hij)
  let ρ := finiteLocalizedNormalFunctional M ψ p hp ξ hlocal s
  have hvalues : (ρ.val.val : StrongDual ℂ M) =
      ψ.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M).flip P) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro a
    change (ρ.val.val : StrongDual ℂ M) a = ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * P)
    exact ρ.property a
  refine ⟨ρ.val, ρ.property, ?_⟩
  rw [hvalues]
  exact positiveFunctional_rightProjection_residual_norm_le M ψ P hP

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Generated
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CharacterMultiplierContinuous

/-!
# The Weyl von Neumann algebra on the original scalar Haar L2 space

The actual Haar left translations and pointwise continuous-character
multipliers generate a concrete von Neumann algebra on the full `Lp ℂ 2 μ`.
The two families are the existing bounded operators on that same carrier.
Their membership proofs restrict the original unitaries to the generated
algebra, retaining both their operator values and their a.e. coordinates.

Characters use the positive convention `χ(s) ξ(s)`. The inverse character
uses the same original multiplier at `χ⁻¹`; it is also an original generator.
This strict construction does not use a factor-generation equality.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uG

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The original scalar Haar translations and actual pointwise character multipliers. -/
def haarWeylGenerators : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  Set.range (fun g : G =>
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g :
      Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ∪
    Set.range (HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ)

/-- The von Neumann algebra generated by the original Weyl operators on the full scalar Haar L2. -/
def haarWeylAlgebra : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  generatedBy (haarWeylGenerators μ)

/-- The carrier is the actual double commutant of the star algebra of the original Weyl operators. -/
@[simp]
theorem coe_haarWeylAlgebra :
    (haarWeylAlgebra μ : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)) =
      Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer
        (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (haarWeylGenerators μ) : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
  coe_generatedBy (haarWeylGenerators μ)

/-- Every original scalar Haar left translation belongs to the same generated algebra. -/
theorem haarLeftRegular_mem_haarWeylAlgebra (g : G) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g :
      Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ∈ haarWeylAlgebra μ :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self g))

/-- Every actual positive-character multiplier belongs to the same generated algebra. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_mem_haarWeylAlgebra (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ ∈ haarWeylAlgebra μ :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self χ))

/-- The actual inverse-character multiplier is itself an original generator in the same algebra. -/
theorem inverseCharacterMultiplier_mem_haarWeylAlgebra (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ⁻¹ ∈ haarWeylAlgebra μ :=
  characterMultiplier_mem_haarWeylAlgebra μ χ⁻¹

/-- The original Haar left translation, restricted by its proved generator membership. -/
def haarWeylTranslationUnitary (g : G) : unitary (haarWeylAlgebra μ) :=
  ⟨⟨StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g,
      haarLeftRegular_mem_haarWeylAlgebra μ g⟩, by
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g).property.1
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g).property.2⟩

/-- The generated-algebra translation is the exact original bounded Haar operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarWeylTranslationUnitary_coe (g : G) :
    ((haarWeylTranslationUnitary μ g : haarWeylAlgebra μ) : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) =
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g :
        Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  rfl

/-- The generated-algebra translation has the original `g⁻¹ s` coordinates a.e. -/
theorem haarWeylTranslationUnitary_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ((haarWeylTranslationUnitary μ g : haarWeylAlgebra μ) :
      Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => ξ (g⁻¹ * s) :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ ℂ g ξ

/-- The original character unitary, restricted by its proved generator membership. -/
def haarWeylCharacterUnitary (χ : PontryaginDual G) : unitary (haarWeylAlgebra μ) :=
  ⟨⟨HaarL2.characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ,
      characterMultiplier_mem_haarWeylAlgebra μ χ⟩, by
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (HaarL2.characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ).property.1
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (HaarL2.characterMultiplierUnitary (H := ℂ) μ χ).property.2⟩

/-- The generated-algebra character is the exact original pointwise bounded operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem haarWeylCharacterUnitary_coe (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    ((haarWeylCharacterUnitary μ χ : haarWeylAlgebra μ) : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) =
      HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ :=
  rfl

/-- The generated-algebra character keeps the original positive-character coordinates a.e. -/
theorem haarWeylCharacterUnitary_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ξ : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ((haarWeylCharacterUnitary μ χ : haarWeylAlgebra μ) :
      Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
        fun s : G => ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s :=
  HaarL2.characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ ξ

/-- The same actual generator at the inverse character retains its literal inverse convention a.e. -/
theorem haarWeylInverseCharacterUnitary_ae_eq (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ξ : Lp ℂ 2 μ) :
    ((haarWeylCharacterUnitary μ χ⁻¹ : haarWeylAlgebra μ) :
      Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
        fun s : G => ((χ⁻¹ s : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ s :=
  haarWeylCharacterUnitary_ae_eq μ χ⁻¹ ξ

/-- Containment of this actual Weyl algebra is precisely containment of its two original families. -/
theorem haarWeylAlgebra_le_iff (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
    haarWeylAlgebra μ ≤ N ↔
      (∀ g : G, (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g :
        Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ∈ N) ∧
      ∀ χ : PontryaginDual G, HaarL2.characterMultiplier (H := ℂ) μ χ ∈ N := by
  rw [haarWeylAlgebra, generatedBy_le_iff]
  simp only [haarWeylGenerators, Set.union_subset_iff, Set.range_subset_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

/-- The actual generated Weyl carrier is closed in the stock weak operator topology. -/
theorem haarWeylAlgebra_isClosedWOT :
    IsClosed {T : Lp ℂ 2 μ →WOT[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ | T.toCLM ∈ haarWeylAlgebra μ} :=
  generatedBy_isClosedWOT (haarWeylGenerators μ)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.VectorFunctionalCriterion
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# Actual spatial normal operator maps between the original Hilbert spaces

Conjugation by an actual linear isometry equivalence sends a concrete
von Neumann algebra into the full original target operator algebra.
Its vector-functional pullback is the original source functional on the
inverse-transformed vectors, so the actual source predual proves normality.

This constructor supplies the normal coefficient map on the verified
H-first Borel product model. No normality, source model, Fourier unitary
or normalized dual Haar certificate is supplied. Both Hilbert universes
are independent and either Hilbert space may be zero.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uH uK

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable (e : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)

/-- Restrict the original spatial operator conjugation to the source algebra and full target. -/
def isometryConjugationStarAlgHom : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K) where
  toFun x := ⟨e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H), by trivial⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_one e.conjStarAlgEquiv
  map_mul' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_mul e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
  map_zero' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_zero e.conjStarAlgEquiv
  map_add' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_add e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
  commutes' c := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change e.conjStarAlgEquiv (algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) c) = algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) c
    exact AlgEquivClass.commutes e.conjStarAlgEquiv c
  map_star' x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_star e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H)

/-- The restricted spatial map has the exact original bounded-operator value. -/
theorem isometryConjugationStarAlgHom_coe (x : M) :
    (isometryConjugationStarAlgHom e M x : K →L[ℂ] K) =
      e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H) := rfl

/-- Its computed vector pullback is the original functional on inverse-transformed vectors. -/
theorem isometryConjugation_vectorFunctional (ξ η : K) (x : M) :
    vectorFunctional (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K) ξ η (isometryConjugationStarAlgHom e M x) =
      vectorFunctional M (e.symm ξ) (e.symm η) x := by
  simp only [vectorFunctional_apply, isometryConjugationStarAlgHom_coe,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply]
  exact (e.symm.inner_map_eq_flip ξ ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) (e.symm η))).symm

/-- The exact spatial map is normal by its actual source vector-functional pullbacks. -/
def isometryConjugationNormalHom : NormalStarAlgHom M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K) := by
  let f := isometryConjugationStarAlgHom e M
  refine NormalStarAlgHom.ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks f ?_
  intro ξ η
  have hEq : (vectorFunctional (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K) ξ η).comp
      (⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩ : M →L[ℂ] (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K)) =
      vectorFunctional M (e.symm ξ) (e.symm η) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact isometryConjugation_vectorFunctional e M ξ η x
  rw [hEq]
  exact vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M (e.symm ξ) (e.symm η)

/-- The normal bundle retains the same original spatial operator value. -/
theorem isometryConjugationNormalHom_coe (x : M) :
    (isometryConjugationNormalHom e M x : K →L[ℂ] K) =
      e.conjStarAlgEquiv (x : H →L[ℂ] H) := rfl

/-- Acting on a target vector uses the actual inverse and forward Hilbert maps. -/
theorem isometryConjugationNormalHom_apply_apply (x : M) (ξ : K) :
    (isometryConjugationNormalHom e M x : K →L[ℂ] K) ξ =
      e ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) (e.symm ξ)) := rfl

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveSupremum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveLUBLimit
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Positive
public import Mathlib.Order.Zorn

/-!
# An actual local positive comparison operator against the original vector functional

The comparison set consists of original positive operators below a with
vector value at most the original positive functional value. Each original
nonempty chain has its actual bounded positive supremum. The vector
functional's proved ultraweak continuity and positivity of the original
functional put that supremum back in the comparison set. Zorn gives an
actual maximal comparison element; its difference from a is the positive
nonzero operator on which the local strict comparison holds.

The dominating vector functional is the actual Hilbert coefficient. No
normal-functional model, local-comparison output or source theorem is
supplied as data. These prerequisites serve the localized-functional
construction for the computed GNS normal homomorphism; terminal source
proofs and global normal-functional membership remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight Filter Set
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct the original positive local-comparison operator from its actual dominating vector. -/
def localVectorComparisonPositiveElement (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (a : PositiveElement M) → (ξ : H) →
      (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a : M)).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (a : M)).re →
      {b : PositiveElement M //
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) (a : M) ∧ (b : M) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ t : PositiveElement M, (t : M) ≠ 0 →
          @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (t : M) (b : M) →
          (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (t : M)).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re} := by
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  letI : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  letI : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  letI : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  letI : IsOrderedAddMonoid M := StarOrderedRing.toIsOrderedAddMonoid
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ a ξ hcompare
  let φ : StrongDual ℂ M := ψ.toContinuousLinearMap
  have horders (z w : ℂ) : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE z w ↔
      @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE z w := by
    have hspectral : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE z w ↔
        ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun s : ℂ => star s * s) ∧ w = z + d := by
      let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
      let : LE ℂ := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE
      let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
      exact StarOrderedRing.le_iff z w
    have hstandard : @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE z w ↔
        ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun s : ℂ => star s * s) ∧ w = z + d := by
      let : PartialOrder ℂ := Complex.partialOrder
      let : LE ℂ := Complex.partialOrder.toLE
      let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := RCLike.toStarOrderedRing
      exact StarOrderedRing.le_iff z w
    exact hspectral.trans hstandard.symm
  have hmono (x y : M) (hxy : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE x y) :
      (φ x).re ≤ (φ y).re := by
    have hspectral : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE (φ x) (φ y) := ψ.monotone' hxy
    exact ((horders (φ x) (φ y)).mp hspectral).1
  let positiveOrder : PartialOrder (PositiveElement M) :=
    @PartialOrder.lift (PositiveElement M) M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M)
      (fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) Subtype.val_injective
  letI : PartialOrder (PositiveElement M) := positiveOrder
  letI : Preorder (PositiveElement M) := positiveOrder.toPreorder
  letI : LE (PositiveElement M) := positiveOrder.toLE
  have positive_le_iff (p q : PositiveElement M) :
      @LE.le (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toLE p q ↔
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M) := Iff.rfl
  let C : Set (PositiveElement M) :=
    {c | @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (c : M) (a : M) ∧
      (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (c : M)).re ≤ (φ (c : M)).re}
  let z : PositiveElement M := ⟨0, @le_refl M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder 0⟩
  have hzC : z ∈ C := by
    change (0 : M) ≤ (a : M) ∧ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ 0).re ≤ (φ 0).re
    exact ⟨a.property, by simp⟩
  have hchains (S : Set (PositiveElement M)) (hSC : S ⊆ C)
      (hchain : IsChain (fun p q => @LE.le (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toLE p q) S) :
      ∃ ub ∈ C, ∀ p ∈ S, @LE.le (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toLE p ub := by
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
    · exact ⟨z, hzC, by simp⟩
    have hdir : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M)) S := by
      intro p hp q hq
      rcases hchain.total hp hq with hpq | hqp
      · exact ⟨q, hq, (positive_le_iff p q).mp hpq,
          @le_refl M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder (q : M)⟩
      · exact ⟨p, hp, @le_refl M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder (p : M),
          (positive_le_iff q p).mp hqp⟩
    have hbound : ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ ‖(a : M)‖ := by
      intro p hp
      exact CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg (hSC hp).1 p.property
    let ub : PositiveElement M :=
      (boundedPositiveSupremum M S hne hdir ‖(a : M)‖ hbound).val
    have hLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' S) (ub : M) :=
      boundedPositiveSupremum_isLUB M S hne hdir ‖(a : M)‖ hbound
    have hubA : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (ub : M) (a : M) := by
      apply hLUB.2
      rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      exact (hSC hp).1
    let preS : Preorder S := @Preorder.lift S M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
      (fun p : S => (p.val : M))
    let : Preorder S := preS
    let : LE S := preS.toLE
    have index_le_iff (p q : S) : @LE.le S preS.toLE p q ↔
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p.val : M) (q.val : M) := Iff.rfl
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hne
    let : Nonempty S := ⟨⟨p₀, hp₀⟩⟩
    let : @IsDirectedOrder S preS.toLE :=
      ⟨fun p q => by
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr, hqr⟩ := hdir p.val p.property q.val q.property
        exact ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, (index_le_iff p ⟨r, hr⟩).mpr hpr,
          (index_le_iff q ⟨r, hr⟩).mpr hqr⟩⟩
    have hmonoNet : @Monotone S M preS (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
        (fun p : S => (p.val : M)) := by
      intro p q hpq
      exact (index_le_iff p q).mp hpq
    have hrange : Set.range (fun p : S => (p.val : M)) =
        ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' S) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, rfl⟩
    have hnetLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        (Set.range fun p : S => (p.val : M)) (ub : M) := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact hLUB
    have hlimit := boundedPositiveIsLUB_tendsto_ultraweak M (fun p : S => (p.val : M)) (ub : M)
      hmonoNet (fun p => p.val.property) ⟨‖(a : M)‖, fun p => hbound p.val p.property⟩ hnetLUB
    let v : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
      ⟨vectorFunctional M ξ ξ, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M ξ ξ⟩
    have hcontinuous : Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
        ((v : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)).re :=
      Complex.continuous_re.comp (ultraweak_eval_continuous M v)
    have hvectorLimit : Tendsto (fun p : S => (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (p.val : M)).re) atTop
        (𝓝 (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (ub : M)).re) := by
      simpa only [v, Function.comp_def, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
        hcontinuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlimit
    have hupper : ∀ p : S, (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (p.val : M)).re ≤ (φ (ub : M)).re := by
      intro p
      exact (hSC p.property).2.trans (hmono (p.val : M) (ub : M) (hLUB.1 ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩))
    have hubCompare : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (ub : M)).re ≤ (φ (ub : M)).re :=
      le_of_tendsto' hvectorLimit hupper
    refine ⟨ub, ⟨hubA, hubCompare⟩, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    exact (positive_le_iff p ub).mpr (hLUB.1 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  let maximalExists := @zorn_le₀ (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toPreorder C hchains
  let m : PositiveElement M := Classical.choose maximalExists
  have hm := Classical.choose_spec maximalExists
  let b : PositiveElement M := ⟨(a : M) - (m : M), sub_nonneg.mpr hm.1.1⟩
  have hbA : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) (a : M) :=
    sub_le_self (a : M) m.property
  have hbNonzero : (b : M) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hbzero
    have ham : (a : M) = (m : M) := sub_eq_zero.mp hbzero
    have hstrict : (φ (a : M)).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (a : M)).re := hcompare
    rw [ham] at hstrict
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hm.1.2) hstrict
  have hbLocal (t : PositiveElement M) (htNonzero : (t : M) ≠ 0)
      (htb : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (t : M) (b : M)) :
      (φ (t : M)).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re := by
    by_contra hnot
    have htCompare : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re ≤ (φ (t : M)).re := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hd0 : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE 0 ((m : M) + (t : M)) :=
      add_nonneg m.property t.property
    let d : PositiveElement M := ⟨(m : M) + (t : M), hd0⟩
    have hdA : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (d : M) (a : M) := by
      have h : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
          ((t : M) + (m : M)) (((a : M) - (m : M)) + (m : M)) :=
        add_le_add_left htb (m : M)
      have hrhs : ((a : M) - (m : M)) + (m : M) = (a : M) := sub_add_cancel _ _
      rw [hrhs] at h
      calc
        (m : M) + (t : M) = (t : M) + (m : M) := add_comm _ _
        _ ≤ (a : M) := h
    have hdCompare : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (d : M)).re ≤ (φ (d : M)).re := by
      change (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ ((m : M) + (t : M))).re ≤ (φ ((m : M) + (t : M))).re
      simp only [map_add, Complex.add_re]
      exact add_le_add hm.1.2 htCompare
    have hmd : @LE.le (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toLE m d := by
      apply (positive_le_iff m d).mpr
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right t.property
    have hdm : @LE.le (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder.toLE d m := by
      apply hm.2
      · exact ⟨hdA, hdCompare⟩
      · exact hmd
    have hdeq : d = m := @le_antisymm (PositiveElement M) positiveOrder d m hdm hmd
    have hsum : (m : M) + (t : M) = (m : M) := congrArg (fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) hdeq
    have htzero : (t : M) = 0 := by
      have h : (m : M) + (t : M) = (m : M) + 0 := by simpa only [add_zero] using hsum
      exact add_left_cancel h
    exact htNonzero htzero
  exact ⟨b, hbA, hbNonzero, hbLocal⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.ProjectionVectorDominator
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalVectorComparison
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveCutoffLocalization

/-!
# An actual nonzero projection and vector with literal local positive domination

The original nonzero source projection gives an actual range vector whose
coefficient dominates the original positive functional value. The actual
local comparison operator is then constructed by its verified vector/Zorn
route. Its genuine nonzero cutoff stays below the source projection and
has a strictly positive threshold times the cutoff below that comparison
operator. Scaling original positive test operators by that threshold and
cancelling it proves the literal local domination, including zero tests.

No local-domination, vector/norm, normal member or source-output certificate
is an input. These actual data feed the localized-functional vector bound
and the normal-functional realization constructor.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct actual nonzero source-local projection/vector data with proved local domination. -/
def localVectorDominatedProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (e : M) → IsStarProjection e → e ≠ 0 →
      {q : M × H // IsStarProjection q.1 ∧ q.1 ≠ 0 ∧
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE q.1 e ∧
        ∀ t : PositiveElement M,
          @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (t : M) q.1 →
          (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (t : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M q.2 q.2 (t : M)).re} := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  letI : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  letI : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  letI : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  letI : IsOrderedAddMonoid M := StarOrderedRing.toIsOrderedAddMonoid
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ e he hne
  let φ : StrongDual ℂ M := ψ.toContinuousLinearMap
  let v := projectionVectorDominator M φ e he hne
  let ξ : H := v.val
  have he0 : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE 0 e := by
    simpa only [he.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, he.isIdempotentElem.eq] using star_mul_self_nonneg e
  let a : PositiveElement M := ⟨e, he0⟩
  let b := localVectorComparisonPositiveElement M ψ a ξ v.property.2
  have hbNonzero : (b.val : M) ≠ 0 := b.property.2.1
  let thresholdExists := exists_positiveCutoffProjection_nonzero M b.val hbNonzero
  let r : ℝ := Classical.choose thresholdExists
  have hthreshold := Classical.choose_spec thresholdExists
  have hr : 0 < r := hthreshold.1
  let p : M := positiveCutoffProjection M b.val r
  have hp : IsStarProjection p := positiveCutoffProjection_isStarProjection M b.val r
  have hpNonzero : p ≠ 0 := hthreshold.2
  have hpBelow : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE p e :=
    positiveCutoffProjection_le_projection M b.val e he r hr b.property.1
  have hrp : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (r • p) (b.val : M) :=
    positiveCutoffProjection_threshold M b.val r
  have hlocal (t : PositiveElement M)
      (htp : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (t : M) p) :
      (φ (t : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re := by
    by_cases htzero : (t : M) = 0
    · rw [htzero]
      simp
    · let u : PositiveElement M := positiveSmul (NNReal.mk r hr.le) t
      have huNonzero : (u : M) ≠ 0 := by
        intro huzero
        have hraw := congrArg (fun x : M => r⁻¹ • x) huzero
        have h : (r⁻¹ * ((NNReal.mk r hr.le : NNReal) : ℝ)) • (t : M) = 0 := by
          simpa only [u, positiveSmul, smul_smul, smul_zero] using hraw
        have hcast : ((NNReal.mk r hr.le : NNReal) : ℝ) = r := rfl
        rw [hcast, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul] at h
        exact htzero h
      have huBelow : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (u : M) (b.val : M) := by
        change r • (t : M) ≤ (b.val : M)
        exact (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left htp hr.le).trans hrp
      have hstrict := b.property.2.2 u huNonzero huBelow
      have hφ : (φ (r • (t : M))).re = r * (φ (t : M)).re := by
        change RCLike.re (φ (r • (t : M))) = r * RCLike.re (φ (t : M))
        rw [φ.map_smul_of_tower, RCLike.smul_re]
      have hvector : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (r • (t : M))).re =
          r * (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re := by
        change RCLike.re (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (r • (t : M))) =
          r * RCLike.re (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M))
        rw [(vectorFunctional M ξ ξ).map_smul_of_tower, RCLike.smul_re]
      change (φ (r • (t : M))).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (r • (t : M))).re at hstrict
      rw [hφ, hvector] at hstrict
      have hsmall : (φ (t : M)).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (t : M)).re := by
        nlinarith
      exact hsmall.le
  exact ⟨(p, ξ), hp, hpNonzero, hpBelow, hlocal⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveFunctionalLocalization
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Isomorphisms

/-!
# The localized functional factors through its actual operator evaluation

The evaluation map sends a to (a*p)ξ. The original local positive comparison
bounds the squared norm of ψ(a*p) by that vector's squared norm. Consequently
an operator in the evaluation kernel also belongs to the localized
functional's kernel. This is the kernel prerequisite for factorization
through the actual evaluation range; no norm or normality certificate is
supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual bounded operator-evaluation map a ↦ (a*p)ξ retains its continuity. -/
def localizedOperatorEvaluation (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (p : M) (ξ : H) : M →L[ℂ] H := by
  let A : M →ₗ[ℂ] H :=
    { toFun := fun a => ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        change (((a : H →L[ℂ] H) + (b : H →L[ℂ] H)) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ =
          ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ +
            ((b : H →L[ℂ] H) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ
        rw [add_mul, add_apply]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c a
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
        change ((c • (a : H →L[ℂ] H)) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ =
          c • (((a : H →L[ℂ] H) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ)
        rw [smul_mul_assoc, smul_apply] }
  have hbound (a : M) : ‖A a‖ ≤ (‖p‖ * ‖ξ‖) * ‖a‖ := by
    change ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ≤ (‖p‖ * ‖ξ‖) * ‖a‖
    have hmul : ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖p‖ := norm_mul_le a p
    calc
      ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ≤ ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
        ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H).le_opNorm ξ
      _ ≤ (‖a‖ * ‖p‖) * ‖ξ‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmul (norm_nonneg ξ)
      _ = (‖p‖ * ‖ξ‖) * ‖a‖ := by ring
  exact A.mkContinuous (‖p‖ * ‖ξ‖) hbound

/-- The original right-localized bounded functional retains its continuous linear map. -/
def localizedFunctionalLinearMap (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (p : M) :
    M →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  ψ.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M).flip p)

/-- The original local vector comparison proves the actual evaluation-kernel inclusion. -/
theorem localizedOperatorEvaluation_ker_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) (p : M) (_hp : IsStarProjection p) (ξ : H),
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      LinearMap.ker (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap ≤
        LinearMap.ker (localizedFunctionalLinearMap M ψ.toContinuousLinearMap p).toLinearMap := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal a ha
  have hzero : ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ = 0 := ha
  have hbound := localizedPositiveFunctional_norm_sq_le_vector M ψ p hp ξ hlocal a
  rw [hzero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero] at hbound
  have hnorm : ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)‖ = 0 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p))]
  change ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p) = 0
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra
