module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalizedEvaluationKernel

/-!
# Factor the original localized functional through the actual evaluation range

The original local comparison proves the evaluation-kernel inclusion. The
stock surjective-range factorization then constructs a linear functional on
the actual range of a ↦ (a*p)ξ, with literal value ψ(a*p). The value equation
is proved by the stock lift law, rather than supplied as a constructor field.
No norm or normal-functional membership certificate is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual range functional, with its original localized value equation proved internally. -/
def localizedEvaluationRangeFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : M) → IsStarProjection p → (ξ : H) →
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      {g : LinearMap.range (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ //
        ∀ a : M, g ((localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap.rangeRestrict a) =
          ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let A := (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap
  let ρ := (localizedFunctionalLinearMap M ψ.toContinuousLinearMap p).toLinearMap
  have hker : LinearMap.ker A.rangeRestrict ≤ LinearMap.ker ρ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict]
    exact localizedOperatorEvaluation_ker_le M ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let g : LinearMap.range A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
    (A.rangeRestrict.liftOfSurjective A.surjective_rangeRestrict) ⟨ρ, hker⟩
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  intro a
  change (A.rangeRestrict.liftOfSurjective A.surjective_rangeRestrict)
    ⟨ρ, hker⟩ (A.rangeRestrict a) = ρ a
  exact LinearMap.equivOfSurjective_apply A.surjective_rangeRestrict hker

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalizedEvaluationRange
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt

/-!
# The original localized evaluation-range functional is bounded

The existing squared vector bound implies a norm bound with constant
sqrt(‖ψ(1)‖). Every point of the actual evaluation range has an original
operator preimage, so the same estimate bounds the constructed range
functional. Its continuous linear map and original localized value equation
are constructed without a supplied norm or normality certificate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original range factor is bounded, with its norm estimate and literal values proved internally. -/
def localizedEvaluationRangeBoundedFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : M) → IsStarProjection p → (ξ : H) →
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      {g : StrongDual ℂ (LinearMap.range (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap) //
        (∀ a : M, g ((localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap.rangeRestrict a) =
          ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)) ∧
        ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖ * ‖x‖} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let A := (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap
  let factor := localizedEvaluationRangeFunctional M ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  have hbound (a : M) : ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖ * ‖A a‖ := by
    have hsquare := localizedPositiveFunctional_norm_sq_le_vector M ψ p hp ξ hlocal a
    change ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖ * ‖A a‖ ^ 2
      at hsquare
    have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsquare
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul (norm_nonneg _) _,
      Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h
    exact h
  have hfactor (x : LinearMap.range A) : ‖factor.val x‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖ * ‖x‖ := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := A.surjective_rangeRestrict x
    rw [factor.property a]
    exact hbound a
  let g : StrongDual ℂ (LinearMap.range A) :=
    factor.val.mkContinuous (Real.sqrt ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖) hfactor
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    change factor.val (A.rangeRestrict a) = ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)
    exact factor.property a
  · intro x
    exact hfactor x

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalizedVectorRealization

/-!
# The original localized functional is an actual normal vector functional

The constructed Riesz vector η represents ψ(a*p) at (a*p)ξ. The original
operator product rewrites this as the vector coefficient at a of η and pξ.
That coefficient belongs to the existing closed normal-functional span.
The resulting normal-functional data have the original localized values;
no normal membership, vector witness or norm certificate is supplied.

This is a local constructor. The global order-normal criterion and the
computed normal GNS homomorphism require separate remaining prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct the original localized functional in the actual normal-functional space. -/
def localizedNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : M) → IsStarProjection p → (ξ : H) →
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      {ρ : normalFunctionalSpace M // ∀ a : M,
        (ρ.val : StrongDual ℂ M) a = ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let η := localizedFunctionalVector M ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let ω : H := (p : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ
  let ρ : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
    ⟨vectorFunctional M η.val ω, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M η.val ω⟩
  refine ⟨ρ, ?_⟩
  intro a
  change vectorFunctional M η.val ω a = ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)
  rw [vectorFunctional_apply, η.property a]
  have hproduct : ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ = (a : H →L[ℂ] H) ω := by
    change ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) * (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ = _
    rw [mul_apply_eq_comp]
  rw [hproduct]

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalizedEvaluationRangeBounded
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.HahnBanach
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Dual

/-!
# Realize the original localized functional by an actual Hilbert vector

The bounded functional on the actual evaluation range has a stock
Hahn--Banach extension. Riesz duality applied to that internally obtained
extension constructs a vector with the exact original localized coefficient
values. Neither an extension, a norm certificate nor normal membership is
an input. The global order-normal criterion is a separate remaining step.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct a genuine Riesz vector representing the original localized functional values. -/
def localizedFunctionalVector (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) → (p : M) → IsStarProjection p → (ξ : H) →
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      {η : H // ∀ a : M, ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p) =
        ⟪η, ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let A := (localizedOperatorEvaluation M p ξ).toLinearMap
  let g := localizedEvaluationRangeBoundedFunctional M ψ p hp ξ hlocal
  let extensionExists := exists_extension_norm_eq (LinearMap.range A) g.val
  let extension : StrongDual ℂ H := Classical.choose extensionExists
  have hextension := Classical.choose_spec extensionExists
  let η : H := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℂ H).symm extension
  refine ⟨η, ?_⟩
  intro a
  calc
    ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p) = g.val (A.rangeRestrict a) := (g.property.1 a).symm
    _ = extension (A a) := (hextension.1 (A.rangeRestrict a)).symm
    _ = ⟪η, A a⟫_ℂ := (InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply).symm
    _ = ⟪η, ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ := rfl

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalCutoffProjection
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalProjectionAnnihilator
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Projection

/-!
# The actual maximal-family finite-cutoff supremum is the original identity

Each original family member is the value of its actual singleton cutoff,
so it lies below the constructed cutoff supremum s. Both are genuine star
projections; therefore s*p=p for every family member p. Its star-projection
complement 1-s annihilates the entire actual family. The proved original
maximal-family annihilator law gives 1-s=0 and hence s=1. No identity limit,
LUB, projection or normality certificate is supplied as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped BigOperators

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual maximal-family finite positive cutoffs have original identity as their constructed supremum. -/
theorem maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_eq_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      ((maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).val : M) = 1 := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  let : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  let : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  let S := maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ
  let P := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ
  let s := maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ
  have hs : IsStarProjection (s.val : M) := maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isStarProjection M ψ
  have hmember (p : M) (hp : p ∈ S.val) : p ≤ (s.val : M) := by
    let i : S.val := ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hvalue : (P.val {i} : M) = p := by
      rw [(maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_value M ψ) {i}]
      change (∑ j ∈ ({i} : Finset S.val), (j.val : M)) = (i.val : M)
      exact Finset.sum_singleton (fun j : S.val => (j.val : M)) i
    have h := (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isLUB M ψ).1 (Set.mem_range_self ({i} : Finset S.val))
    rw [hvalue] at h
    exact h
  have hcomplement : (1 : M) - (s.val : M) = 0 := by
    apply maximalLocalProjectionFamily_annihilator_eq_zero M ψ (1 - (s.val : M)) hs.one_sub
    intro p hp
    have hprod : (s.val : M) * p = p :=
      ((S.property.1 p hp).1.le_iff_mul_eq_right hs).mp (hmember p hp)
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hprod, sub_self]
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hcomplement).symm

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalCutoffSupremum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MultiplicationPredual
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveLUBLimit
public import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Finset

/-!
# The actual finite-cutoff positive supremum is a star projection

The constructed positive supremum s lies between every original finite
projection cutoff P and the identity. Positivity of 1-s below 1-P gives
s*P=P. The actual nonbottom finite-set filter converges ultraweakly to s;
fixed-left multiplication by s is continuous for that original topology.
Limit uniqueness then gives s*s=s. Positivity gives its original star law.
No projection or convergence certificate is supplied as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The internally constructed original positive finite-cutoff supremum is a genuine star projection. -/
theorem maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isStarProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      IsStarProjection ((maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).val : M) := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  let : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  let : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : IsOrderedAddMonoid M := StarOrderedRing.toIsOrderedAddMonoid
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  let P := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ
  let s := maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ
  let a := fun t => (P.val t : M)
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun t => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a t)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (s.val : M))) :=
    boundedPositiveIsLUB_tendsto_ultraweak M a (s.val : M)
      (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_monotone M ψ) (fun t => (P.val t).property)
      ⟨1, (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_norm_le_one M ψ)⟩ (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isLUB M ψ)
  have hfix (t) : (s.val : M) * a t = a t := by
    have hP : IsStarProjection (a t) := (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_isStarProjection M ψ) t
    have hPs : a t ≤ (s.val : M) := (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isLUB M ψ).1 (Set.mem_range_self t)
    have hres : 0 ≤ (1 : M) - (s.val : M) := sub_nonneg.mpr (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_le_one M ψ)
    have hresle : (1 : M) - (s.val : M) ≤ 1 - a t := sub_le_sub_left hPs 1
    have h := hP.one_sub.mul_right_and_mul_left_of_nonneg_of_le hres hresle
    have hzero : ((1 : M) - (s.val : M)) * a t = 0 := by
      have hproduct := h.1
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one] at hproduct
      exact (sub_eq_self.mp hproduct)
    have hid := hzero
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, sub_eq_zero] at hid
    exact hid.symm
  have hmult := (ultraweak_left_mul_continuous M (s.val : M)).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlimit
  have hsame : (fun t => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm ((s.val : M) * a t)) =
      (fun t => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a t)) := by
    funext t
    rw [hfix]
  have htarget : Tendsto (fun t => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm ((s.val : M) * a t)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm ((s.val : M) * (s.val : M)))) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hmult
  rw [hsame] at htarget
  have hid : (s.val : M) * (s.val : M) = (s.val : M) :=
    (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm.injective (tendsto_nhds_unique htarget hlimit)
  exact ⟨hid, IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg s.val.property⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalFiniteCutoffs
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveSupremum

/-!
# The actual positive supremum of the maximal family's finite cutoffs

The strict finite-cutoff constructor proves positivity, norm≤1, nonemptiness
and directedness from original ψ. Feeding precisely those actual fields to
the strict bounded-positive-supremum constructor gives an original positive
least upper bound of the literal cutoff range. Its norm≤1 and order≤1 are
proved internally. No LUB, projection limit or normal member is an input.
The supremum's projection law and zero complement remain subsequent steps.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct the actual original finite-cutoff positive LUB with original norm and identity bounds. -/
def maximalLocalCutoffSupremum (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) →
      let P := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ
      {s : PositiveElement M //
        @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
          (Set.range fun t => (P.val t : M)) (s : M) ∧
        ‖(s : M)‖ ≤ 1 ∧ @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (s : M) 1} := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  letI : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  letI : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  letI : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  let P := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ
  have hnonempty : (Set.range P.val).Nonempty := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_range_nonempty M ψ
  have hdirected : DirectedOn (fun a b : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) (b : M)) (Set.range P.val) :=
    maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_directedOn M ψ
  have hbound (p : PositiveElement M) (hp : p ∈ Set.range P.val) : ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_norm_le_one M ψ) t
  let s := boundedPositiveSupremum M (Set.range P.val) hnonempty hdirected 1 hbound
  have hrange : ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' Set.range P.val) =
      Set.range (fun t => (P.val t : M)) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨t, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_range_self t
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨P.val t, Set.mem_range_self t, rfl⟩
  have hLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      (Set.range fun t => (P.val t : M)) (s.val : M) := by
    rw [← hrange]
    exact s.property.1
  have hunit : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (s.val : M) 1 := by
    apply hLUB.2
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_le_one M ψ) t
  exact ⟨s.val, hLUB, s.property.2, hunit⟩

/-- The constructed cutoff supremum is the least upper bound of the literal cutoff values. -/
theorem maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isLUB (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        (Set.range fun t => ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M))
        ((maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).val : M) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).property.1

/-- The same constructed cutoff supremum has norm at most one. -/
theorem maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_norm_le_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      ‖((maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).val : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).property.2.1

/-- The same constructed cutoff supremum lies below the identity in the spectral order. -/
theorem maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_le_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE ((maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).val : M) 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalCutoffSupremum M ψ).property.2.2

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalProjectionFamily
public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Star.StarProjection.FiniteSum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Projection
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset

/-!
# Actual bounded positive finite cutoffs of the maximal local projection family

Each cutoff is the literal sum of a finite set of members of the original
constructed maximal family. Its star-projection law gives positivity and
bounds it by the original identity. The original C-star norm gives norm≤1.
Finite unions and positivity make the actual range directed; the empty
finite set supplies nonemptiness. No cutoff family, positivity, norm bound,
supremum, projection limit or normal member certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped BigOperators

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct the actual positive finite-sum cutoffs and all prerequisites of their bounded supremum. -/
def maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) →
      let S := maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ
      {P : Finset S.val → PositiveElement M //
        (∀ t, (P t : M) = ∑ p ∈ t, (p.val : M)) ∧
        (∀ t, IsStarProjection (P t : M)) ∧
        (∀ t, @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (P t : M) 1) ∧
        (∀ t, ‖(P t : M)‖ ≤ 1) ∧
        (@Monotone (Finset S.val) M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
          (fun t => (P t : M))) ∧
        (Set.range P).Nonempty ∧
        DirectedOn (fun a b : PositiveElement M =>
          @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) (b : M)) (Set.range P)} := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  letI : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  letI : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  letI : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  letI : IsOrderedAddMonoid M := StarOrderedRing.toIsOrderedAddMonoid
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  let S := maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ
  let sum (t : Finset S.val) : M := ∑ p ∈ t, (p.val : M)
  have hsum (t : Finset S.val) : IsStarProjection (sum t) := by
    apply IsStarProjection.finset_sum_of_pairwise_mul_eq_zero
    · intro p _hp
      exact (S.property.1 p.val p.property).1
    · intro p _hp q _hq hpq
      exact S.property.2.1 p.property q.property
        (fun h => hpq (Subtype.ext h))
  let P (t : Finset S.val) : PositiveElement M := ⟨sum t, (hsum t).nonneg⟩
  have hone (t : Finset S.val) : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (P t : M) 1 :=
    (hsum t).le_one
  have hnorm (t : Finset S.val) : ‖(P t : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg (hone t) (P t).property
    have hunit : ‖(1 : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      change ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H‖ ≤ 1
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
    exact h.trans hunit
  have hmono : @Monotone (Finset S.val) M inferInstance
      (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder (fun t => (P t : M)) := by
    intro t v htv
    change sum t ≤ sum v
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg htv
    intro p _hp _hpt
    exact (S.property.1 p.val p.property).1.nonneg
  refine ⟨P, (fun _ => rfl), hsum, hone, hnorm, hmono, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨P ∅, Set.mem_range_self ∅⟩
  · intro a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨P (t ∪ v), Set.mem_range_self (t ∪ v), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hmono Finset.subset_union_left
    · exact hmono Finset.subset_union_right

/-- Every actual cutoff is the literal finite sum of its original family members. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_value (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ)
      (t : Finset (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val),
      ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M) = ∑ p ∈ t, (p.val : M) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ t
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.1 t

/-- Each constructed finite cutoff is a star projection. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_isStarProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ)
      (t : Finset (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val),
      IsStarProjection ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ t
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.1 t

/-- Every actual finite cutoff is bounded above by the identity in the spectral order. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_le_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ)
      (t : Finset (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val),
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M) 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ t
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.2.1 t

/-- Every actual finite cutoff has norm at most one. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_norm_le_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ)
      (t : Finset (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val),
      ‖((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M)‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ t
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.2.2.1 t

/-- The actual cutoff values are monotone in their finite index sets. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_monotone (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      @Monotone (Finset (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val) M inferInstance
        (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
        (fun t => ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val t : M)) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.2.2.2.1

/-- The range of actual cutoffs is nonempty, including the empty finite cutoff. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_range_nonempty (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      (Set.range (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val).Nonempty := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.2.2.2.2.1

/-- The actual positive cutoff range is directed in the original spectral order. -/
theorem maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_directedOn (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      DirectedOn (fun a b : PositiveElement M =>
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) (b : M))
        (Set.range (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).val) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  exact (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ).property.2.2.2.2.2.2

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalProjectionFamily
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Projection

/-!
# No nonzero star projection annihilates the actual maximal local family

For a nonzero original projection e, the actual local construction supplies
a nonzero locally dominated projection F≤e. If e annihilates every member
of the constructed maximal family, so does F. Selfadjointness supplies the
reverse zero products; inserting F contradicts actual maximality. The
finite-cutoff supremum and its limiting behavior remain separate next data.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An original star projection orthogonal to the actual maximal family must be zero. -/
theorem maximalLocalProjectionFamily_annihilator_eq_zero (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) (e : M), IsStarProjection e →
      (∀ p ∈ (maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ).val, e * p = 0) → e = 0 := by
  classical
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ e he hannihilator
  by_contra hne
  let S := maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ
  let q := localVectorDominatedProjection M ψ e he hne
  let F : M := q.val.1
  have hF : IsStarProjection F := q.property.1
  have hFne : F ≠ 0 := q.property.2.1
  have hFe : F * e = F := (hF.le_iff_mul_eq_left he).mp q.property.2.2.1
  have hFS (p : M) (hp : p ∈ S.val) : F * p = 0 := by
    calc
      F * p = (F * e) * p := by rw [hFe]
      _ = F * (e * p) := mul_assoc F e p
      _ = 0 := by rw [hannihilator p hp, mul_zero]
  have hSF (p : M) (hp : p ∈ S.val) : p * F = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg star (hFS p hp)
    simpa only [star_mul, hF.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,
      (S.property.1 p hp).1.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, star_zero] using h
  have hFnot : F ∉ S.val := by
    intro hmem
    have hz := hFS F hmem
    rw [hF.isIdempotentElem.eq] at hz
    exact hFne hz
  have heligible : ∀ p ∈ insert F S.val, IsStarProjection p ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ ξ : H,
      ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · exact ⟨hF, hFne, q.val.2, q.property.2.2.2⟩
    · exact S.property.1 p hp
  have hpairwise : (insert F S.val).Pairwise (fun p t => p * t = 0) := by
    intro p hp t ht hpt
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · rcases ht with rfl | ht
      · exact (hpt rfl).elim
      · exact hFS t ht
    · rcases ht with rfl | ht
      · exact hSF p hp
      · exact S.property.2.1 hp ht hpt
  have hinsert : insert F S.val ⊆ S.val :=
    S.property.2.2 (insert F S.val) heligible hpairwise (Set.subset_insert F S.val)
  exact hFnot (hinsert (Set.mem_insert F S.val))

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.LocalVectorDominatedProjection
public import Mathlib.Order.Zorn

/-!
# An actual maximal orthogonal family of locally dominated original projections

The eligible original operators are nonzero star projections admitting the
literal vector comparison on their positive corner. Chain unions preserve
these operator conditions and pairwise zero products. Zorn's lemma therefore
constructs a maximal set of such original projections. Only that internally
proved witness is chosen; no family, limit, normal member or norm certificate
is an input. Completeness of the finite cutoffs is a separate next step.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Construct a maximal family of original nonzero projections with genuine local vector comparison. -/
def maximalLocalProjectionFamily (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) →
      {S : Set M //
        (∀ p ∈ S, IsStarProjection p ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ ξ : H,
          ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
            @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
            (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) ∧
        S.Pairwise (fun p q => p * q = 0) ∧
        ∀ T : Set M,
          (∀ p ∈ T, IsStarProjection p ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ ξ : H,
            ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
              @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
              (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
          T.Pairwise (fun p q => p * q = 0) → S ⊆ T → T ⊆ S} := by
  classical
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ
  let eligible (p : M) : Prop := IsStarProjection p ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ ξ : H,
    ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
      (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re
  let families : Set (Set M) := {S | (∀ p ∈ S, eligible p) ∧ S.Pairwise (fun p q => p * q = 0)}
  have hchain (C : Set (Set M)) (hC : C ⊆ families) (hc : IsChain (· ⊆ ·) C) :
      ∃ U ∈ families, ∀ S ∈ C, S ⊆ U := by
    refine ⟨⋃₀ C, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨S, hSC, hpS⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hp
        exact (hC hSC).1 p hpS
      · intro p hp q hq hpq
        obtain ⟨S, hSC, hpS⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hp
        obtain ⟨T, hTC, hqT⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hq
        by_cases hST : S = T
        · subst T
          exact (hC hSC).2 hpS hqT hpq
        · rcases hc hSC hTC hST with hsub | hsub
          · exact (hC hTC).2 (hsub hpS) hqT hpq
          · exact (hC hSC).2 hpS (hsub hqT) hpq
    · intro S hSC p hpS
      exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨S, hSC, hpS⟩
  have maximalExists : ∃ S, Maximal (· ∈ families) S := zorn_subset families hchain
  let S : Set M := Classical.choose maximalExists
  have hS := Classical.choose_spec maximalExists
  refine ⟨S, hS.1.1, hS.1.2, ?_⟩
  intro T hTel hTpair hST
  exact hS.2 ⟨hTel, hTpair⟩ hST

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Mul
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear

/-!
# Fixed multiplication on the actual normal predual and ultraweak algebra

Original fixed-left multiplication pulls the actual bounded functional
back by its literal product formula. Vector coefficients become the
original adjoint-shifted vector coefficients. This preserves the actual
norm-closed normal-functional span and proves continuity in the original
ultraweak view. No scalar weight or GNS supplier is needed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

universe uH

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Actual bounded functional precomposition by original fixed-left multiplication. -/
def normalFunctionalLeftPullback (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : M) :
    StrongDual ℂ M →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M M ℂ).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M a)

/-- The original bounded functional pullback has the literal original product value. -/
theorem normalFunctionalLeftPullback_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : M)
    (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (x : M) : normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a ψ x = ψ (a * x) :=
  rfl

/-- Fixed-left pullback of an original vector coefficient is the original adjoint-shifted coefficient. -/
theorem normalFunctionalLeftPullback_vectorFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : M)
    (ξ η : H) :
    normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a (vectorFunctional M ξ η) =
      vectorFunctional M (((star a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) η := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [normalFunctionalLeftPullback_apply, vectorFunctional_apply, vectorFunctional_apply]
  change ⟪ξ, (a : H →L[ℂ] H) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (a : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) η) ξ).symm

/-- The actual norm-closed normal-functional span is invariant under original fixed-left pullback. -/
theorem normalFunctionalLeftPullback_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : M)
    (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (hψ : ψ ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a ψ ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  let P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M) :=
    (normalFunctionalSpace M).comap (normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a).toLinearMap
  have hP : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
    change IsClosed ((normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a) ⁻¹'
      (normalFunctionalSpace M : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)))
    exact (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage (normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a).continuous
  have hvec : ∀ ξ η : H, vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ P := by
    intro ξ η
    change normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a (vectorFunctional M ξ η) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M
    rw [normalFunctionalLeftPullback_vectorFunctional]
    exact vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M (((star a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) η
  have hle : normalFunctionalSpace M ≤ P := normalFunctionalSpace_le M hP hvec
  exact hle hψ

/-- Original fixed-left multiplication is continuous for the actual ultraweak topology. -/
theorem ultraweak_left_mul_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : M) :
    Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a * ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) := by
  apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
  intro ψ
  let ψa : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
    ⟨normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M),
      normalFunctionalLeftPullback_mem M a (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) ψ.property⟩
  have hcontinuous := ultraweak_eval_continuous M ψa
  change Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M =>
    normalFunctionalLeftPullback M a (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) at hcontinuous
  change Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (a * ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))
  simpa only [normalFunctionalLeftPullback_apply] using hcontinuous


end VonNeumannAlgebra

end

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalEquiv

/-!
# Normal actions on the actual predual

The action maps into the group of bundled normal star equivalences. Their
derived inverse pullbacks act on the actual closed normal-functional space.
Connes's source continuity condition is norm continuity of these actual
predual orbits, with their original continuous-dual norm and evaluation.

The primal star maps and all algebra values retain their original carriers.
The point sigma-strong-star source formulation keeps its comparison theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An actual normal automorphism action with Connes's norm-continuous predual inverse orbits. -/
structure NormalAction (G : Type uG) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) where
  /-- The actual action in the group of original bundled normal star equivalences. -/
  toMonoidHom : G →* NormalStarAlgEquiv M M
  /-- Norm continuity of every inverse orbit in the actual normal-functional subtype. -/
  continuous_predual_orbit : ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M,
    Continuous fun g : G => NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom M (toMonoidHom g) φ

namespace NormalAction

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

/-- The actual normal automorphism group homomorphism determines the action. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {α β : NormalAction G M} (h : α.toMonoidHom = β.toMonoidHom) : α = β := by
  cases α
  cases β
  cases h
  rfl

@[macro_inline]
instance : FunLike (NormalAction G M) G (NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) where
  coe α := α.toMonoidHom
  coe_injective α β h := by
    have hmap : α.toMonoidHom = β.toMonoidHom :=
      DFunLike.ext _ _ fun g => congrFun h g
    exact ext hmap

instance : MonoidHomClass (NormalAction G M) G (NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) where
  map_one α := α.toMonoidHom.map_one
  map_mul α := α.toMonoidHom.map_mul

/-- The action map and original normal automorphism have the same value. -/
@[simp]
theorem toMonoidHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) : α.toMonoidHom g = α g :=
  rfl

/-- The original star automorphism action obtained by forgetting the proved normal data. -/
def toStarAlgAutHom (α : NormalAction G M) : G →* (M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M) :=
  (NormalStarAlgEquiv.toStarAlgAutHom M).comp α.toMonoidHom

/-- The original algebra action evaluates at the same original point. -/
@[simp]
theorem toStarAlgAutHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    α.toStarAlgAutHom g x = α g x :=
  rfl

/-- Each action value has its actual ultraweak continuity from the normal equivalence bundle. -/
theorem continuous_ultraweak (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (α g (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) :=
  (α g).continuous_ultraweak

/-- The induced covariant action on the actual predual, derived from inverse functional pullback. -/
def predualAction (α : NormalAction G M) :
    G →* (normalFunctionalSpace M ≃L[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  (NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom M).comp α.toMonoidHom

/-- The actual predual action uses Connes's exact original inverse-automorphism evaluation. -/
@[simp]
theorem predualAction_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) (x : M) :
    (α.predualAction g φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ((α g).symm x) :=
  NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom_apply (α g) φ x

/-- Every orbit is norm continuous in the actual original predual subtype. -/
theorem predualAction_continuous (α : NormalAction G M) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    Continuous fun g : G => α.predualAction g φ :=
  α.continuous_predual_orbit φ

end NormalAction

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CharacterConjugation
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.UniformConvergence
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.BoundedLinearMaps

/-!
# The actual normal character action on the generated Haar Lp algebra

Inverse spatial pullback sends the original vector functional on ξ and η to
the one on the actual positive-character vectors κχξ and κχη. Their genuine
strong continuity gives norm-continuous vector-functional orbits. All ordinary
dual pullbacks are contractions, so the set of continuous orbits is norm closed.
The actual closed vector-functional span therefore has continuous predual
orbits and supplies the continuity field of the original NormalAction bundle.

This constructs the action on the same actual C_c/Lp generated algebra. The
original Connes tensor transport and source coefficient inclusion keep their
separate construction boundaries.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2
open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra UniformConvergence

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- Actual inverse predual pullback is the original functional on the positive-character vectors. -/
theorem characterConjugation_predual_vectorFunctional (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) :
    (NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom (crossedProductLp μ α) (characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ)
      ⟨vectorFunctional (crossedProductLp μ α) ξ η,
        vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace (crossedProductLp μ α) ξ η⟩ :
        StrongDual ℂ (crossedProductLp μ α)) =
      vectorFunctional (crossedProductLp μ α)
        (characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ η) := by
  let U := characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom_apply]
  simp only [vectorFunctional_apply]
  change ⟪ξ, (star U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
    ((x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ((U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η))⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪(U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ξ,
        (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ((U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η)⟫_ℂ
  calc
    _ = ⟪(star (star U) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ξ,
        (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ((U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η)⟫_ℂ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (star U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
        ((x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ((U : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η)) ξ).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [star_star]

/-- Every original predual orbit is norm continuous for the actual compact-open character topology. -/
theorem characterConjugation_predual_continuous (α : NormalAction G M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace (crossedProductLp μ α)) :
    Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G =>
      NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom (crossedProductLp μ α) (characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ) φ := by
  let X := crossedProductLp μ α
  let A : PontryaginDual G → (StrongDual ℂ X →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ X) := fun χ =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ X X ℂ).flip
      (characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ).symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hbound (χ : PontryaginDual G) (ψ : StrongDual ℂ X) : ‖A χ ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg ψ)
    intro x
    change ‖ψ ((characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ).symm x)‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖x‖
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖(characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ).symm x‖ := ψ.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le
          (characterConjugationNormalHom μ α χ).symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.toStarAlgHom x)
        (norm_nonneg ψ)
  have hLip (χ : PontryaginDual G) : LipschitzWith 1 (A χ) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.mk_one
    intro ψ θ
    simp only [dist_eq_norm]
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact hbound χ (ψ - θ)
  let P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ X) :=
    { carrier := {ψ | Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ}
      zero_mem' := by
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_zero]
        exact continuous_const
      add_mem' := by
        intro ψ θ hψ hθ
        have hcψ : Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ := hψ
        have hcθ : Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ θ := hθ
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        have hfun : (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ (ψ + θ)) =
            (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ) + (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ θ) := by
          funext χ
          rw [Pi.add_apply]
          exact map_add (A χ) ψ θ
        rw [hfun]
        exact hcψ.add hcθ
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c ψ hψ
        have hcψ : Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ := hψ
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        have hfun : (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ (c • ψ)) =
            (fun _ : PontryaginDual G => c) • (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ) := by
          funext χ
          rw [Pi.smul_apply']
          exact map_smul (A χ) c ψ
        rw [hfun]
        exact (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : PontryaginDual G => c).smul hcψ }
  have hOrbitLip : LipschitzWith 1
      (fun ψ : StrongDual ℂ X => UniformFun.ofFun (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ)) :=
    UniformFun.lipschitzWith_ofFun_iff.mpr hLip
  have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ X)) := by
    change IsClosed ((fun ψ : StrongDual ℂ X => UniformFun.ofFun (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ ψ)) ⁻¹'
      {f : PontryaginDual G →ᵤ StrongDual ℂ X | Continuous (UniformFun.toFun f)})
    exact (UniformFun.isClosed_setOfPred_continuous (α := PontryaginDual G) (β := StrongDual ℂ X)).preimage
      hOrbitLip.continuous
  let R₀ : X →ₗ[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    LinearMap.ofClass X.toStarSubalgebra.subtype
  let R : X →L[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := R₀.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    change ‖(x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_rfl)
  let E : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ (Lp H 2 μ)
  let J : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] X →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ := (E.flip.comp R).flip
  let B : Lp H 2 μ →L⋆[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ X :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ X (Lp H 2 μ) ℂ) (innerSL ℂ) J
  have hR (x : X) : R x = (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [LinearMap.mkContinuous_apply]
    rfl
  have hE (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) (T : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) : E ξ T = T ξ := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply ξ T
  have hJ (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) (x : X) : J ξ x = (R x) ξ := by
    dsimp only [J]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact hE ξ (R x)
  have hEval (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) (x : X) :
      B ξ η x = ⟪ξ, (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η⟫_ℂ := by
    calc
      B ξ η x = innerSL ℂ ξ (J η x) := by
        simp only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      _ = ⟪ξ, (R x) η⟫_ℂ := by rw [hJ, innerSL_apply_apply]
      _ = ⟪ξ, (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) η⟫_ℂ := by rw [hR]
  have hB (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) : B ξ η = vectorFunctional X ξ η := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (hEval ξ η x).trans (vectorFunctional_apply X ξ η x).symm
  have hvec (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) : vectorFunctional X ξ η ∈ P := by
    change Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ (vectorFunctional X ξ η)
    have he (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
        A χ (vectorFunctional X ξ η) = B (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ η) := by
      have h := characterConjugation_predual_vectorFunctional μ α χ ξ η
      change A χ (vectorFunctional X ξ η) =
        vectorFunctional X (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ η) at h
      exact h.trans (hB (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ η)).symm
    have hfun : (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ (vectorFunctional X ξ η)) =
        (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => B (characterMultiplier μ χ ξ) (characterMultiplier μ χ η)) := by
      funext χ
      exact he χ
    rw [hfun]
    exact (B.continuous.comp (characterMultiplier_continuous μ ξ)).clm_apply
      (characterMultiplier_continuous μ η)
  have hAll := normalFunctionalSpace_le X hPclosed hvec
  apply continuous_induced_rng.2
  change Continuous fun χ : PontryaginDual G => A χ (φ : StrongDual ℂ X)
  exact hAll φ.property

/-- The computed positive-character normal action with its actual continuous predual inverse orbits. -/
def characterConjugationNormalAction (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalAction (PontryaginDual G) (crossedProductLp μ α) where
  toMonoidHom := characterConjugationNormalHom μ α
  continuous_predual_orbit := characterConjugation_predual_continuous μ α

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CrossedProductLp
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CharacterCovariance
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UnitaryConjugation

/-!
# Actual normal character conjugation on the generated Haar Lp algebra

The original positive-character multiplier preserves the actual star algebra
of regular generators, and therefore its original generated double commutant.
The inverse character gives the actual inverse on that same operator carrier.
Spatial vector-functional pullback supplies its proved normality.

The canonical coefficient map is fixed and the canonical Haar implementer is
scaled by chi(g). This constructs the normal automorphism group map on the
actual C_c/Lp model. The original Connes tensor-carrier transport and normal
source embedding remain their separate source prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The original character multiplier conjugates the same generated operator carrier into itself. -/
theorem characterConjugation_mem_crossedProductLp (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (T : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) (hT : T ∈ crossedProductLp μ α) :
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * T *
      star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ∈
        crossedProductLp μ α := by
  apply unitaryConjugation_generatedBy_mem (crossedProductGenerators μ α)
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ) ?_ T hT
  intro a ha
  rcases ha with (⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨g, rfl⟩)
  · rw [characterMultiplier_fix_regularCoefficient μ α χ x]
    exact StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self x))
  · rw [characterMultiplier_scale_haarLeftRegular μ χ g]
    exact (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (crossedProductGenerators μ α)).smul_mem
      (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self g))) _

/-- Actual character conjugation, with its proved inverse and normality, on the original generated algebra. -/
def characterConjugationNormalEquiv (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv (crossedProductLp μ α) (crossedProductLp μ α) := by
  refine unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv (crossedProductLp μ α)
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ) ?_ ?_
  · intro T hT
    exact characterConjugation_mem_crossedProductLp μ α χ T hT
  · intro T hT
    have hstar : characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ⁻¹ =
        star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ) :=
      (characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ).map_inv χ
    have hinv := characterConjugation_mem_crossedProductLp μ α χ⁻¹ T hT
    simpa only [hstar, Unitary.coe_star, star_star] using hinv

/-- The actual normal automorphism keeps the original positive-character spatial formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem characterConjugationNormalEquiv_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (x : crossedProductLp μ α) :
    (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α χ x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
        (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
        star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical original coefficient map is fixed inside the same generated algebra. -/
theorem characterConjugationNormalEquiv_fix_coefficient (α : NormalAction G M)
    (χ : PontryaginDual G) (x : M) :
    characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α χ (crossedProductCoefficient μ α x) =
      crossedProductCoefficient μ α x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [characterConjugationNormalEquiv_apply, crossedProductCoefficient_apply]
  exact characterMultiplier_fix_regularCoefficient μ α χ x

/-- The canonical original Haar implementer has Connes's exact positive-character scaling. -/
theorem characterConjugationNormalEquiv_scale_group (α : NormalAction G M)
    (χ : PontryaginDual G) (g : G) :
    characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α χ (crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) =
      ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • (crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α χ
    (crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • ((crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
  rw [characterConjugationNormalEquiv_apply, crossedProductGroupUnitary_coe]
  exact characterMultiplier_scale_haarLeftRegular μ χ g

/-- The computed character conjugations form their actual normal automorphism group map. -/
def characterConjugationNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    PontryaginDual G →* NormalStarAlgEquiv (crossedProductLp μ α) (crossedProductLp μ α) where
  toFun := characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α
  map_one' := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α (1 : PontryaginDual G) x :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = (x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
    rw [characterConjugationNormalEquiv_apply]
    have hU := (characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ).map_one
    change characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ (1 : PontryaginDual G) =
      (1 : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)) at hU
    rw [hU]
    simp only [Submonoid.coe_one, star_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  map_mul' χ ψ := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α (χ * ψ) x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α χ (characterConjugationNormalEquiv μ α ψ x) :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ)
    simp only [characterConjugationNormalEquiv_apply]
    have hU := (characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ).map_mul χ ψ
    change characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ (χ * ψ) =
      characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ * characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ ψ at hU
    rw [hU]
    simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, star_mul, mul_assoc]

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra
